title.native: 蘇るミイラ
花麝香の園
俺俺俺俺俺俺俺とお前
title.romaji: Ore Ore Ore Ore Ore Ore Ore to Omae

215004.description:
Sabu is a cool and handsome rock-n-roller. Chicks dig him, but he’s obsessed with Mari, his pretty neighbor. But Mari loves someone else, which Sabu cannot bear to even think about—nor can his evil doppelganger. Who is that? Is it just my shadow? Or is it another me, lurking there, peering and plotting, in The Darkness?!

An imaginative and unsettling adaptation of Edogawa Ranpo’s classic story The Stalker in the Attic, Koga Shinichi’s The Darkness shows one of horror manga’s pioneers applying his astonishing artistry and palpitating pacing to comics for a more mature audience. Reinforced by three other horrifying stories from the early 1970s.

(Source: Living the Line)

title.native: くらやみ
謎の終列車
妖怪地獄
僕の家政婦さんはスキだらけ!?

1. Watashi-tachi ga Soap Shite Ageru (私たちがソープしてあげる)
2. Sakunyuu Inma Chi-Che (搾乳淫魔チーチェ)
3. Kuruki Irie no Shouka ni te (黒き入江の娼家にて)

12. Kowasare Ai (コワサレアイ)

title.native: ちちゆりラプソディ

215014.description:
Alba, a rather lazy adventurer, accidentally unseals the legendary holy sword while searching for treasure.
Suddenly, Rita, the spirit dwelling within the holy sword, appears before him, but her attitude is rather strange...
This is the start of an adventure with the holy sword, and its tsundere spirit that hates all humans!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 聖剣ちゃんはこじらせている

215015.description:
Twenty years ago, the small European kingdom of Nabotavia was the site of a revolution that forced the royal family, the Roseanovas, out of their kingdom. Weeks ago, Prince Damian of the ousted Roseanovas was involved in a horrific speedboat accident that took his sight, and left him with a life of cynicism. With only a fifty-fifty chance of his eyesight returning, Sara Joplin's been hired to help him cope with his blindness. There's one small catch: she has two weeks to transform him back into the prince he is or this chance for the Roseanovas to return to power will be completely out of sight. Can she handle a prince that doesn't want her help?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 光と闇のプリンス

215016.description:
Abby is the only daughter of the president of a car manufacturing company. She turns away any men who approach her and, as such, is known as the Ice Princess. On the evening of her father's birthday party, she meets the billionaire entrepreneur, Laird. After the party, she takes him on a drive, but their car breaks down. They spend the night in the car together, and the next day, they're outed by the paparazzi. Abby's father collapses in shock at the scandal, but Laird steps in with an olive branch. They should get married with certain conditions...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 冷徹なCEOの情熱

215017.description:
Jana has been hired as a tutor in the desert country of Central Barakat. However, when the father of her pupils introduces himself, she realizes that he's the ruler of Barakat, King Omar. "You will be the teacher of my daughters, the princesses," he says. Though Jana is struck by Omar's good looks, she also finds him brusque. Since the death of his wife, Omar's heart has been frozen as solid as ice. What can she do to touch his heart? Jana starts to formulate a plan to melt his defences, but is her plan a good idea?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 突然…結婚！

215018.description:
After a terrible incident with love left her heartbroken and jobless, Dominique throws love to the wind and is on the prowl for a rich husband she can wrap around her finger. When brewing magnate Charles Brandon takes a liking to her, she's inexplicably apprehensive. By some stroke of luck, Charles fell head over heals in love with Dominique the moment he laid eyes on her. He has a complex about his looks: he's older and he's extremely wealthy. He's the perfect candidate for her scheme! So why is she so uneasy?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: A Rich Man's Revenge Three Rich Men
title.native: 五億ドルの愛人 恋はポーカーゲーム

215019.description:
For just one night, shy Tina wishes she could be a woman who is confident and attractive. So when she meets a devilishly handsome man at Carnival in Venice, she casts caution to the wind and gives her virginity to him. They remain masked and spend an enchanted night together. But the very next morning when Tina peeks underneath his mask while he sleeps, she discovers her brother's rival-Nico! Shocked by the irony of fate, she runs away without a word only to find, two months later, that she is carrying his baby!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: ベネチアの夜に燃えて
なんてミステリアス！

215021.description:
Anna was once the companion of the Earl of Lawton's daughter. She grew up beside her and they received the same education...until she was suddenly relieved of her duties and introduced to her future employer-Lord Brentmore. Lord Brentmore had lost his wife and was now looking for a family tutor. He was doubtful of Anna's usefulness but hired her regardless. A handsome but mysterious lord, a cold servant, an air of mystery... Anna's struggle has begun!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: わたしだけの侯爵

215022.description:
After Jessica narrowly avoids an avalanche on a mountain road, she is rescued by a handsome stranger named Morgan. Though he seems cold, she's relieved by his offer to stay with her until the roads are cleared, despite the way her heart involuntarily flutters at just the sight of him. But after the snow is cleared, Jessica's car won't start, so Morgan invites her to stay at his house. But what they don't know is that a dangerous man is coming to take revenge on prosecutor Morgan...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 危険な聖夜

215023.description:
After being severely injured in an accident, Amber overhears that she has only six months to live. She decides she'll enjoy the little time she has left and goes to a luxurious bar. There she meets Wolf and spends the night with him. She leaves the following morning without saying goodbye, knowing this can be nothing more than a cherished memory for her. A few months later, Amber's visiting her friend on holiday when she sees none other than Wolf, whose real name is Dyson!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: こはく色の乙女と銀の狼
title.romaji: Kohakushoku no Otome to Gin no Ookami

215024.description:
Lysan was engaged before she realized what had happened...or so it felt to her. When her childhood friend Noel lost his parents, her attempts to comfort him blew up into an engagement... Her family is elated, but Lysan herself is unsettled and decides to take a journey...to the country where Dante, a man she once met, lives. In a confused daze, Lysan steps foot in a foreign land...and runs right into Dante himself!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: フィアンセがいるのに

215025.description:
In an effort to rescue her father, Alesia dresses up like a man and sneaks into the royal palace. However, she is caught by the handsome prince of the Bacar Kingdom, Halil Rasheed, who quickly recognizes her as a woman! It is then that Halil offers Alesia a harrowing proposition in order to save her from this predicament: "In exchange for the release of your father, you will become my concubine."

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 氷のシークに囚われて
プリンセスへの招待

215027.description:
Princess Joelle of Ducasse doesn't even know what Prince Luigi Borgarde's face looks like, but it is her destiny to marry him and give birth to an heir for the sake of her country. Unable to accept this fate, Joelle sets out to spend a year in the United States. Just once, she wants to know sweet and passionate love. Under a false name, she takes on a job as a singer and awaits her chance. Finally, on her last night of freedom, she spots a man in the audience who won't take his eyes off her. Joelle's heart is racing. She wants to go all the way with him. An illicit affair is about to begin!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: The Italian's Virgin Princess Princess Brides III
title.native: プリンセスの歌声
ただひとり、あなただけ

215029.description:
After a year at war, Captain Ivo Trenchard returns to England to visit his beloved aunt in Somerset. He survived the throes of war unscathed and now, to his chagrin, he's bedridden for weeks because of a simple animal rescue gone awry. Luckily, the local tomboy Jossie Calverton Morley suffers from a guilty conscience and visits him every day, ensuring he's never bored. But what's the brave captain to do when this enchanting innocent suddenly begs him to teach her how to kiss?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 華麗なるデビュー

215030.description:
"I promise to give you the best moment of your life," whispers a beautiful, mysterious man after a passionate kiss. Those words make Farah throw all reason out the door. Career woman Farah is actually a desert princess, and had just found out that she is to be in an arranged marriage with a prince from a neighboring kingdom. Farah has always wanted to marry the man she falls in love with, and hoped that this man, who made her crazy, would be the one. Hot passion takes her over. Please, take me now! At that moment, the man's eyes shine like a beast.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: エメラルドの妖精
さまよえる相続人
おれは美少女VTuber

215033.description:
Princess Aliyah arrives to her wedding in a black wedding dress. This is a declaration of war to her husband, King Kamal. Seven years ago, the two were in a relationship, but he messed around with her and then left her. Now, the two of them end up in an arranged marriage, and she is being forced to give him an heir. Aliyah treats him coldly during the ceremony and that resistence awakens something within him. As the drums pronounce them husband and wife, Kamal takes Aliyah into the depths of the palace into his bedroom. Unable to hold himself back anymore, he rips off her black dress...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 流砂の獅子

215034.description:
Deep in the gorgeous Missouri countryside stands the Hotel Crosby, run by former lawyer Elissa. Having lost her parents at a young age, protecting her two sisters and their quaint hotel is everything to Elissa. However, those peaceful days come to an end with the arrival of a man gripping the deed to the land. Sporting jet black hair and an assertive demeanor, he tells Elissa she has until next Spring to vacate the premises so he can build a golf course on the land. The hotel means the world to Elissa, and she's not about to let some man destroy her happiness without a fight.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 雪降る町の恋

215035.description:
Maya, who grew up an orphan, married the first son of the Sabbatini family, a wealthy hotel tycoon, but her failure to give him a successor has created a divide between her and the rest of his family. Five years later, she left the marriage...and Giorgio didn't even try to stop her. Months afterward, she bumped into him again, and their passions led to one last encounter... Six month after that, she found out that she's finally pregnant...but, for the child's sake, she won't let that cold family know about it!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 幸せという名の罠
title.romaji: Shiawase to Iu Na no Wana

title.native: 傷ついたレディ～婚約破棄された私が幸せになるまで～
title.romaji: Kizutsuita Lady: Konyaku Hakisareta Watashi ga Shiawase ni naru made

215037.description:
"Lauren, the president of a graphic arts company, was proposed to by Jason, a major advertising agency owner. However, they had only spent one night together four months ago. When Jason found out that Lauren is pregnant, he suddenly appears in front of her to marry her just for the sake of their child. With her company on the verge of bankruptcy, she coldly rejected his proposal, but from that day on, he started bombarding her with gifts and even offered money to rebuild the company! When he said, ""I want to take care of you and the child,"" her heart is shaken...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 嘘つきなダイヤモンド
暗闇のファンタジー

215039.description:
Single mother Keira must summon up her courage and finally face her son's father, Italian billionaire Mateo. Ten months ago, Keira was assigned to be Mateo's driver, but a sudden change in the weather one day forced them to take refuge at a small B and B...where they spent an unforgettably passionate night together! But when morning came, Mateo was gone, leaving behind only a large sum of money and a small life growing inside her. When Mateo learns of the consequence of their night together, though, he immediately confronts Keira and accuses her of keeping his son a secret!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 純潔を買われた朝
さわらないで佐原さん！
夜空に赤い薔薇を
美しすぎる暗殺者

215043.description:
Alice travels to Italy to interview for a job as a nanny, accompanied by her troublesome niece, Louise. Louise spots a flashy sports car parked on the road and jumps in for a joyride, but her stunt ends up causing an accident! The car, it turns out, belongs to the count who was looking to hire Alice... With disgust in his eyes, the count gives her a choice: go to his house, or be charged with theft.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 妻になる代償

215044.description:
One fateful day, Shannon was offered the acting role of a lifetime and pay to match its grandeur. Since she could pass for the pPrincess Iliana's twin, Greta and Freddy wanted Shannon to stand- in for the currently ill princess during everyday the occasions she was required to attend over the next few days. To Shannon, a grad school student drowning in debt who waitedand waiting tables for a living, this opportunity was too good to pass up. She figured that waving at people and cutting ribbons couldn't be all that difficult. It's It wasn'tnot until she's she was forced to meet the princess's Iliana's fiance while pretending to be the princess that she starts started to fear this job was much more than she'd bargained for.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 偽りのプリンセス
フィレンツェの薔薇

215046.description:
Five months ago, the prince of the great country of Silvershire was assassinated. The main suspect is the leader of an antimonarchy movement, Nikolas Donovan. Fleeing to Paris to escape the rumors, he is pursued by a special agent from the kingdom. However, after she sneaks into his apartment to capture him, Nikolas is surprised by who he sees. The assailant is a fearless, beautiful young woman...one who he has seen before!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 反逆のプリンス

215047.description:
Cassandra, who works for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Silvershire, is seen as uptight and uninterested in men. The truth is she's waiting for the love of her life to breeze in and blow through her heart like a storm. One day, she is assigned to be a guide to Sheik Kadir, a guest visiting from a desert nation. The moment she sees him exiting the plane, her heart starts beating wildly. Impossible... This beautiful sheik with jet-black hair is her soul mate?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: シークに焦がれる夜に

215048.description: Keita Toono and Naoya Ayaori, high school boys, are childhood friends. The two boys, both without girlfriends, pray at a shrine for a girlfriend that matches them as well as they do with each other. The deity hears their request, and they obtain a switch that allows them to switch genders!
synonyms: If I Press the Switch, I'll Turn Into a Girl!?

title.native: スイッチ押したら俺が女子!?
愛と憎しみの迷宮

215050.description:
Princess Sydney of the Kingdom of Naessa is only royalty by name. Even though she was raised in a life of privilege, she has been scorned for being an illegitimate child, and lived her life not knowing her true family. One day, Reginald, the prince of the great kingdom of Silvershire, approaches her with great interest, and she ends up letting him make her his. However, when the prince learns of her pregnancy, he abandons her. Then a tall handsome man appears to her. "You must be Princess Sydney of the Silvershire royal family," he says... The prince was terrible to her. What will this man do?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 愛を知らない王女
とらわれの夜
愛に気づかずに

synonyms: Educating My Childhood Friend: From Total Loner to Top-Tier Gyaru

title.english: Educating My Former Loner Friend Who's Now a Top-Tier Gyaru ❤︎
title.native: カースト最上位ギャルが元陰キャの幼馴染だったので教育する
title.romaji: Caste Saijoui Gal ga Moto Inkya no Osananajimi Datta node Kyouiku Suru

215055.description:
Sophy had felt protective of her sister and her nephew ever since the family of her sister's late husband, Theo, had opposed their son's marriage. That's why she followed her sister to Greece when she went to visit Theo's family. When they arrived, Theo's attractive brother, Andreas, picked them up and brought them back to his breathtaking mansion, but his welcome was less than warm! Still, as Sophy spends time with Andreas under the Greek sun, her heart becomes more conflicted. Now she doesn't know what to do...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 愛の異邦人

215056.description:
Due to a heart condition when she was little, Dorothea was told she would not live past twenty, but thanks to her mother's support, she thrived and even earned herself a degree in archaeology from Oxford. However, when her beloved mother passes away suddenly, Dorothea has no choice but to live with her distant father in London. On her way there, she meets a disheveled American man by the name of Jack Temple, who is looking for someone. After twenty years apart, Dorothea is looking forward to meeting her scholarly father...who is actually the cunning thief that Jack is searching for!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 聖なる刻印
後輩ちゃんはやりすぎる

215058.description:
Having inherited a big estate on the outskirts of London, Octavia is lighthearted as she sets out to see the property. Upon arrival, she comes across two girls-a smart, quiet girl who reminds her of a storybook princess, and her younger sister, a tomboy who looks like a tiny fairy. Confused, Octavia is led by the sisters to meet their uncle Edward Barraclough, who believes she has come seeking a job as a governess... Little does he know she's actually the new owner!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 奇妙な家庭教師
花嫁には秘密

215060.description:
Those crimson eyes look like they want nothing more than to turn this whole world to ash.... But I would die happy if he killed me right now. Ashlyn has a strange power: she hears the voices of the past that linger in this world. Since she was a child, she's lived a noisy and lonesome life. But when she hears the rumors of angels living in an ancient castle in Budapest, she can't help but venture into their forest. There, she sees a muscular man covered in fresh blood, a man who advances on her with murder in his eyes. But instead of fear, she feels a complete and total silence descend upon her. And an indescribable sense of security...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: The Darkest Night Lords of the Underworld I
title.native: オリンポスの咎人I マドックス
魅惑の貴公子

215062.description:
...So, will this ugly angel pull me out of chaos-? Long ago, beautiful, immortal warriors were created by the gods to maintain law and order in heaven. But these warriors fell Now, housing demons within themselves, the warriors live on earth for centuries in solitary, waiting for the god's grace. Anya, the goddess of anarchy, arrives in Budapest to check out on these rumors. Contrary to her beautiful appearance, wild Anya brings disaster and chaos wherever she goes. These warriors were just supposed to be a great time-killer; however...!?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: The Darkest Kiss Lords of the Underworld II
title.native: オリンポスの咎人Ⅱ ルシアン

215063.description:
Even if I'm afraid of him and hate him, I can't forget him... Exiled from Olympus, Reyes, a Guardian of the Gods, lives in a forest in Budapest for thousands of years with a demon sealed away in his body. A tourist from the United States, Danika, meets him and her life completely changes. Not knowing the reason, she becomes imprisoned in a castle of terrifying warriors. Though she was lucky enough to escape, her life became one of wandering around in hiding. Even so, she caught herself unable to forget the Guardian Reyes who toyed with her feelings. He's not human. He's a man too dangerous to love, but...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: The Darkest Pleasure Lords of the Underworld III
title.native: オリンポスの咎人III レイエス
恋を忘れた公爵

215065.description:
Gwen's the vessel of the legendary creatures called harpies and, because of that, was caught to be experimented on. Then one day, a brawny warrior by the name of Sabin appears and releases her from her glass cage. Unfortunately, her sense of relief is short-lived. Sabin, in the distant past, suffered the wrath of the gods, and had sealed within him a terrible, dark and suspicious warrior. He wants to use the harpy's natural prowess as a killer, and so takes her back to his castle. There he tells her that she is now his, and he carves his mark into her neck. Gwen bounces between feelings of anxiety and attraction...

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: オリンポスの咎人Ⅳ サビン

title.english: The Darkest Whisper Lords of the Underworld 4
title.native: オリンポスの咎人 サビン

215066.description:
Angel Olivia appears out of nowhere in front of Dark Warrior Aeron. She claims that she went through numerous obstacles just to come to see Aeron. Aeron, who had no interest in women before, is shaken after spending time with Olivia, who conveys her love to him with her purest heart. Aeron can't accept her love since he is a sinner, and he does not think he is a match for an angel. At the same time, demon Legion becomes very jealous to see Aeron being so stirred by Olivia and eventually makes a deal with Lucifer, the Prince of Darkness, in an attempt to possess Aeron for herself.

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: オリンポスの咎人V アーロン

title.english: The Darkest Passion Lords of the Underworld 5
title.native: オリンポスの咎人 アーロン

215067.description:
A man realized that he had been reincarnated as the extreme masochist (Do-M) villain Wraith Validoor from the Game "Holy Orb Fantasy" he used to Play in his previous life──In order to resist his own ruinous End, he resolves to begin training in magic and swordsmanship. Ever since then, starting with the Main Heroine who is destined to defeat him, the Heroines appearing in the Game begin to show up one after another before Wraith. ……But something about them has changed from the time in the Game!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as a Notorious Degenerate Noble, but Somehow Ended Up With a Genuine Harem

title.native: 極悪非道な性癖貴族が努力したら誠実ハーレムつくれました
title.romaji: Gokuakuhidou na Seiheki Kizoku ga Doryoku Shitara Seijitsu Harem Tsukuremashita

215068.description:
At long last, he'll finally have his revenge. He, Atlas, remembers when Nike, a goddess, had trapped him, a Titan. She had carved her name into his chest, and even now it burned and ached. Following the fall of the Greek gods, he's become responsible for this prison. His imprisonment, until only a few days earlier, is still fresh and raw in his mind, especially the female prison guard, Nike. She had tried to claim his body for herself by carving her name into him, and the hatred he feels for her can only be reduced by inflicting the same humiliation upon her. He pins her down, while she screams and cries, and carves his own name into her porcelain-white back. After he is done, he commits to memory this dark yet pleasant feeling. With this she will know who she belongs to.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: The Darkest Prison Lords of the Underworld 3.5
title.native: オリンポスの咎人 女神の烙印
title.romaji: Olympus no Toganin: Megami no Rakuin

215069.description:
"Please, God. Don't take any more of the people I love." Graced with beauty and wealth, Roma Lombard dreamed of an ordinary life as a preschool teacher. But the Lombard heiress has been the target of envy and jealousy since she was a little girl just because of her birthright, and her oldest brother was even killed over it. And so, her brothers bring in the "perfect bodyguard." When she sees his muscles of steel and the noticeable scar on his cheek, Roma is frozen with horror. Ben McCabe! Anyone but him. He is too dangerous.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 美しきターゲット

215070.description:
Hiro Takanashi is transported to another world due to a mistake by the goddess. As an apology, he is granted the cheat skill of "being popular with girls of the other world," but before he knows it, he's surrounded only by "scary female officers of the Demon King’s army"!! Popular? With these girls, of all people!? A harem comedy filled with enemy characters begins!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: Demon Girls and My Decadent Isekai Life

title.native: 魔族の娘たちと送る乱れた異世界生活
title.romaji: Mazoku no Musumetachi to Okuru Midareta Isekai Seikatsu

215071.description:
Kent, a cynical adventurer earning daily wages, receives a summons from the guild one day. There, the highly anticipated super elite rookie, Cordelia, had already been called in. The guild orders them to form a party because they have "the greatest compatibility in history", but!? The strongest pair consisting of a bottom-tier adventurer living day-to-day and an elite beautiful girl with strong ambitions goes wild day and night♪

(Source: Takecomic, translated)
synonyms: As a Result of Forming a Party with a Woman Who Has Perfect Compatibility on an Adventurer Matching App but the Worst Personality, Our Ecchi Compatibility Exceeded 200%, So She Became the Best Teammate Who is Docile at Night

title.native: 冒険者マッチングアプリで相性抜群だけど性格最悪な女とパーティー組んだ結果、エッチ相性が２００％超えだったので夜は従順な最高のチームメイトになりました。
title.romaji: Boukensha Matching App De Aishou Batsugun Dakedo Seikaku Saiakuna Onna To Party Kunda Kekka, Ecchi Aishou Ga 200% Koe Datta Node Yoru Wa Juujunna Saikou No Teammate Ni Narimashita

215072.description:
This Christmas Eve was supposed to be the best day of Lisa's life. However, instead of the proposal she was expecting to get from her boyfriend, she was publicly chastised by Oliver Davenport. title.romaji: Onii-sama ga Suki Sugiru Kono Imouto wo, Ai wo Motte Wakanrasete Kudasaimashi

215136.description:
Q: Why did you choose this high school?
A: Because my future wife is enrolling here.
When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past. Standing before me was Arisugawa Yuki, my future wife, wearing a school uniform I don't recognize. In the original timeline, we wouldn't meet until we became adults and eventually got married, so we're still strangers for now. But I know that she distrusts people, has no friends, and spends her school days alone. I also know she'll deeply regret that time in the future. So this time, I'm going to rewrite her youth.
"How do you know my secret!?"
"Because we're husband and wife... in the future."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Only One Who Knows How to Make Her Fall for Me Is the Future Me Who Marries Her

title.native: 彼女をデレさせる方法を、将来結婚する俺だけが知っている

title.native: ASSAULT☆ANGEL レンジャーっ娘さんズ

215138.description:
After joining the Royal Knights, Theo was harassed by his superiors every day for five years. His salary was low for a job so demanding that he rarely had a chance to return to his room, and he was reaching his limits mentally and physically. One day, she is taken on as a housekeeper by an S-rank adventurer who is rumored to be able to fight as well as the military. She has no livelihood at all, and her condition is to support him. The job is a billion times better than the work of the knighthood, and the pay is off the charts. Theo accepts her request, and in effect, changes his job to a pimp. Being with the strongest adventurer is a constant source of trouble, but with her, its all cute. Theo does his chores today. To make her happy. A heartwarming otherworldly fantasy about a former bottom-feeding knight who changed his job to housekeeper and the strongest and most beautiful adventurer.

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)
synonyms: The Story of a Corporate Slave Knight Who Gets Picked Up by an S-Rank Adventurer and Becomes Her Kept Man ~A Slow Life While Being Spoiled~

title.native: 社畜騎士がSランク冒険者に拾われてヒモになる話～おいしい料理は絆を繋ぐ!?～
title.romaji: Shachiku Kishi ga S-Rank Boukensha ni Hirowarete Himo ni Naru Hanashi: Oishii Ryouri wa Kizuna wo Tsunagu!?

title.native: 牛のママと少年

215140.description:
One day, at the front door of game-loving modern elementary schooler Hare arrives… a bunny-eared “demihuman maid”!?
She's a mysterious being who is just a little bit “off”. While she works her hardest at housework, she's always spinning her wheels. To make matters worse, she gets way too close for comfort, and her sense of scale is totally glitched out—Hare’s heart won't stop racing!?
Even though she’s a total klutz, for some reason, you just can't help but want her by your side. A new-style daily life comedy begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 亜人のうさぎさんとハレくん

215142.description:
“His Dungeon Exploration Partner Is a High School Girl!?”
Masato, the eldest son of the Jingu family, begins working as an explorer in the “Tokyo Dungeon” to support his younger brothers after their parents pass away. However, realizing the limits of working alone, he decides to look for companions to help conquer the dungeon. That is when his younger brother Rekka introduces him to Tachibana Rika, and the two form a party together. They encounter many hardships along the way, but as they support each other and overcome those challenges together, their bond gradually grows deeper...!?

(Source: Amazia, translated)
synonyms: Experience into Skills, I Gained an All-Purpose Ability and Became the Strongest Explorer ~Rising Through Dungeon Exploration Together with a High School Girl~

title.native: 経験をスキルにする万能な能力を手に入れて、最強の探索者になりました〜JKと一緒にダンジョン探索で成り上がる〜
title.romaji: Keiken wo Skill ni Suru Bannou na Nouryoku wo Te ni Irete, Saikyou no Tansakusha ni Narimashita: JK to Issho ni Dungeon Tansaku de Nariagaru

title.native: TSっこの発情期♡
월계수 가지 사이로

215145.description:
A world where Demons run rampant. Those who hunt those Demons also existed. The SSS-Rank Hunter "Cynthia of the Silver Sword" is one day introduced to an "Underground Quest" that is said to offer a large reward. However, that was an Ecchi request in name only, far from actual exorcism...!? The Fantasy - Ero Quest conquest tale begins here!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: Hunter Guild's Secret Quests ~I'm an SSS Rank, so I Can Afford to Do Naughty Quests (?) It Is~

title.romaji: Hunter Guild no Ura Quest: SSS Rank no Watashi nara Ecchi Quest mo Yoyuu (?) desu

title.native: 愛の忘れもの

215147.description:
Lee-Jun is just an unknown actor filling in as a guest at an engagement ceremony—until he discovers the groom is Jae-Hyun Cha, the star he spent a night with days ago. Worse, Jae-Hyun is hiding a dangerous secret: he's an omega living as an alpha. Now, their unexpected reunion could change everything.

(Source: Manta)

title.native: 인 어 센트
過去からのラブレター

215149.description:
A brand-new “Sage” series from Shinkoshoto, the author of “The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest” and “My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class,” brought to life as a manga with breathtaking artwork by Nao Emoto, known for “O Maidens in Your Savage Season.”
Neiton Magius was born into a prestigious family of mages, yet he had absolutely no magic power from birth. Even so, Neiton loved magic, and dreaming of becoming a magical researcher someday, he devoted himself to magical studies. Then, one day, through his father’s recommendation, he ends up taking the entrance exam for the “Mage Corps,” an elite unit of mages…

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: The Strongest Sage with 0 Magic Power: After Mastering Magic Theory, I Became the Strongest in the World

title.native: 魔力ゼロの最強賢者　～魔法理論を極めたら、世界最強になっていた～
title.romaji: Maryoku Zero no Saikyou Kenja: Mahou Riron wo Kiwametara, Sekai Saikyou ni Natteita

215150.description:
He's lazy, arrogant, and a total scumbag, but his potential is the strongest in the world?! One day, the protagonist reincarnates as "Shin Darkside", a villain noble from a game he was super into. A life full of ruin flags drives the protagonist into despair, but it turns out Shin has the cheat skill [Gluttonous Demon King], a mighty power which lets him devour other's magic and skills to turn them into his own! "If I train this skill to break its limit, maybe I can escape these ruin flags?" With the knowledge of the original story from his past life and the Gluttony Demon King skill, Shin tries to defy his doomed future! Without realizing it, he starts acting like a main character... and before long, cute heroines from the original story and powerful allies who admire the former tyrant Lord Shin start gathering at his side...?!

(Source: Manga Bang, translated)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as a Villainous Noble With the Calamitous-Level Skill Gluttony Demon King, but I Don't Want to Be Executed, so I Hide My Skills and Work Hard

title.native: 災厄級スキル〈暴食魔王〉持ちの悪役貴族に転生しましたが、処刑されたくないのでスキルを隠してひたすら努力します。
title.romaji: Saiyaku-kyuu Skill <Boushoku Maou>-mochi no Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei shimashita ga, Shokei saretakunai node Skill wo Kakushite Hitasura Doryoku shimasu.

215151.description:
In her previous life, she was an overworked office lady trapped in a black company. Now, she’s been reincarnated as Seraphina, the villainess of an otome game! Being the bad guy is way too much work—and after a lifetime of exhausting labor, all she wants in this life is to relax and be lazy forever! Determined to avoid her doom and enjoy endless naps, she sets out to live a slow, carefree life… but for some reason, everyone around her starts to grow fond of her instead!? Before she knows it, she’s fallen right into the overprotective love route!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: The Doomed Villainess Who Accidentally Won the Prince's Devotion
he Result of the Villainess Striving to Act Like the Heroine to Avoid Her Destruction: Although She Longs for a Lazy Retirement, She's Confused by Entering the Second Prince's Obsessive Love Route

title.native: 破滅を控えた悪役令嬢が無理してヒロインを演じた結果～怠惰な余生が憧れなのに、第二王子の溺愛ルートに困惑中～
title.romaji: Hametsu wo Hikaeta Akuyaku Reijou ga Muri Shite Heroine wo Enjita Kekka: Taida na Yosei ga Akogare nanoni, Daini Ouji no Dekiai Route ni Konwaku-chuu

215152.description:
Hikaru, who died at just 20 years old, was granted reincarnation in another world by a goddess's mercy. But due to a mistake, he wasn't reborn as a human; he became moss! “I'll die for real if I don't do something!” Terrified to begin his new life as the weakest possible creature with abysmal stats, Hikaru strategizes how to survive using his rebirth bonus: Additional Skill Acquisition. As he defeats nearby small animals with his chosen skills and newly learned magic to grind levels, he makes an incredible discovery: his moss form can evolve into other species.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Starting Life from Moss in Another World

title.native: 苔から始まる異世界ライフ
ビスタ・ダ・ギガンテッサ

215154.description:
Violet-eyed French Princess Celeste is en route to a remote area in Northern England to fulfill an engagement arranged by her father. After a slew of unbelievable hardships, her aunt falls ill and her travelling party is delayed. Brother Guy, a novice monk with unearthly beauty, is hired as a guide. Completely disappointed in women, Brother Guy makes a vow with God to keep silent while serving as the guide to the beautiful princess, totally unaware of the unimaginable, cruel fate that awaits them...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 沈黙の騎士

215155.description:
Seraphina is starting at a new hospital far away from her family, but her fresh start and promotion may be a bit rougher than she expected. While Dr. Nadine Dickson may be as cold as the surgical steel she's proficient with, her bedside manner leads a lot to be desired. And Dr. Liam Latimer, recently returned from abroad, has some dings and bruises on the outside and a heart that truly needs a prescription for Seraphina's tender love! Can she succeed at her new job and take care of her surgeon boss?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: やさしい涙

215156.description:
For the past few months, Kit has been living in fear, terrified by mysterious threatening letters. When her sister invites her to a ballet to get her out of the house, she finds yet another threatening letter between the pages of her program! Frightened and at her wits' end, Kit impulsively rushes backstage. She sees a swan costume and puts it on to make her escape. While wandering around in the swan costume, Kit is saved by a handsome doctor named Jarod. For the first time in months, she's able to rest easy. It's not long before she falls in love, but she may not be as safe as she thinks...

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 狙われたスワン

215157.description:
In need of money, Gwynneth goes to the Kingdom of Zuran to sell the condominium her father left her before he passed away. But due to the constant real-estate frauds that occur in Zuran, she has trouble getting the papers to prove the condo is hers before selling it. To make matters worse, someone else has the key to her condo, and when he slips in one night, Gwynneth makes no effort to resist the mysterious stranger. Luckily, he restrains himself, but he isn't just any random man: it's Sheikh Tarik himself. They both seem to think the condo is theirs and are stuck with each other until the matter is resolved. But Tarik and Gwynneth can't help but be enticed by one another. Will they both be able to resist acting on their feelings?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 真夏の千一夜

215158.description:
When life throws Linden Taylor another gut-wrenching punch, she decides to recover on a beach. She books herself a cruise and it's full speed ahead to an adventure in paradise. Her assumptions are not far off, but what's an adventure without a little kidnapping? To add insult to injury, her captor is none other than the roguishly handsome, albeit infuriating, Steven Dare. Now confined to this remote little island with a handsome devil, Linden's moral compass spins with reckless abandon. How will she find her way to happiness now?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 囚われの恋人
お仕事は花嫁?
弥生!!

215161.description:
After a farming accident injures Giselle Foster, she takes a vacation in the Fala'isi Islands to recover, and there she runs into Roman Magnati, first prince of Illyria. Giselle soon receives chilling news from a farmhand that she is in deeper financial debt than she realized and has no choice but to sell her father's farm. Believing she has nothing left to lose, Giselle joins Roman when he asks her on a trip. Convinced his affections will lead only to a one-night stand, Giselle keeps Roman at arm's length. Is she a fling for Roman, or is there more to it than she realizes? And...what about those magazine pictures of Roman and Leola, Giselle's twin sister?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 優雅な略奪者

215162.description:
Bria Green may be an outstanding architect, but she's struggled to build herself a safe haven from her overbearing father. When she runs into Sam Wali at a conference, she thinks she's found the perfect vacation fling. But when she finds out that he's the prince of Adhara and that he wants her to take on a project in his home country, Bria might just find that the walls she's built to protect her heart have to come tumbling down.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 組まれた王家の結婚
ライラックが薫るとき

215164.description:
I can't believe I'm pregnant! Ellie thinks, devastated. Today is her wedding day, but the father of her baby isn't her groom. Three months ago, on the night of Carnival in Rio, Ellie shared a bed with Diogo Serrador, who was born in the slums and rose to become CEO to one of the world's largest companies. The young millionaire is every woman's dream man. But after spending the night together, he abandoned Ellie and, in her shock, she decided to marry another man. Is it really right to marry him? Then Diogo suddenly appears before her!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: リオの夜は熱く

215165.description:
Rin Nagumo, an intelligence agent for the Karasu Kingdom, infiltrates the Minase household, head of the enemy nation of Ameyane, to gather information. There, he meets Shizuku, a young girl suffering from a serious illness with little time left to live. While initially irritated and envious of her, a stark contrast to his own life spent dirtying his hands for his missions, he gradually finds himself drawn to the warmth she shows him and her determination to live life to the fullest.

(Source: Overlap, translated)
synonyms: Forbidden love nurtured under the moonlight night.

title.native: 月下の秘め恋

synonyms: Tensei Reijo wa Motto Wanna Be Happy

title.native: 転生令嬢はもっと幸せになりたい！アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Tensei Reijou wa Motto Shiawase ni Naritai! Anthology Comic

215167.description:
When a toxic guild dumps their “worthless, junk-making” alchemist, they make the biggest mistake of their lives.

Iluto, an alchemist, is abruptly kicked out of Dragnate—the very guild that recruited him. Forced to go solo, Iluto shifts gears and heads into the forest on a monster survey. But waiting for him there is Noir, the fluffy divine beast that bestowed him the “Random Alchemy” skill! Between a divine beast coveted by several nations, a friendly personality that warms even elves, supreme mana control, and the divine “Random Alchemy” skill, Iluto starts gaining worldwide recognition. As his ex-guild crumbles and scrambles to find a suitable replacement, Iluto is busy assembling his ultimate dream squad with a beautiful elf girl and a fluffy divine beast!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: Wildcard Alchemist: Building the Ultimate Guild With a Divine Fluffy Beast and Random Alchemy Skill
title.native: ギルドを追放されたけどもふもふ神獣に授かった神スキル【ランダム錬金】で最強のギルドを作って無双します
title.romaji: Guild wo Tsuihou Sareta kedo Mofumofu Shinjuu ni Sazukatta Kami Skill [Random Renkin] de Saikyou no Guild wo Tsukutte Musoushimasu

215168.description:
Abuse from his parents, bullying from his classmates. No matter how hard he did the housework and studied, he was never acknowledged. One day, a woman claiming to be a lawyer visits Tatsuya Inoue, a boy who has been continuously oppressed. From that day on, the boy's life changes completely. His wealthy grandfather, Shigeto Sumeragi, spoils his grandson to the extreme. The servants, whose protective instincts are stirred by the boy's youthful appearance, try their best to spoil him. No matter how hard or painful life is, if you keep living, a turning point will surely come... A school comedy about a boy who has suffered more than anyone else, and how he finds himself surrounded by unparalleled happiness!

(Source: Shufu to Seikatsu Sha, translated)
synonyms: When I went back to my parents' house, I started living a pampered life.

title.native: 実家に帰ったら甘やかされ生活が始まりました
title.romaji: Jikka ni Kaettara Amayakasare Seikatsu ga Hajimarimashita

215169.description:
What would you do if the sweet young lady you’ve been caring for turned out to be a handsome young lord and a future villain? Lelia Sharett, a newly hired apothecary of the Roselle household, suddenly regains memories of her past life and realizes she’s living inside her favorite novel, The Saintess Smites Evil. Worse, she remembers that the story’s villain, Clovis Roselle, lives here. Bracing herself, Lelia goes to greet him, only to meet Clarise, a beautiful and sickly girl suffering from her family’s neglect. Determined to help her, Lelia grows close to Clarise, unaware that her lady is harboring a big secret: Clarise is actually Clovis, living in disguise in order to survive.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Lady is a Young Master
title.native: お嬢様？と一夜の過ちを犯しました
title.romaji: Ojou-sama? To Ichiya no Ayamachi wo Okashi Mashita

215170.description:
Jess is a hot, stylish club singer. After leaving her abusive husband, she lives a quiet life with her small daughter. Her neighbor, Rob Carpenter, is a handsome, quiet man who moved to town half a year ago?and Jess secretly has a thing for him. But it was also exactly half a year ago that a string of brutal murders began in town, and the serial killer targets women who look like Jess. Rob is a man of many secrets...and one night, Jess finds herself in his apartment?with a knife at her throat!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 闇夜に口づけを

215171.description:
Amy, despite being of noble birth, is attending a grand party at the famous Lyndhurst Chase estate, not as a lady but as a maid. Her younger brother Ned was last spotted at Lyndhurst before his mysterious disappearance. And there are rumours that Major Anthony, the owner of the Lyndhurst estate, is responsible for the disappearance of his own wife not long ago. What kind of trouble has her brother gotten into? Under the disguise of a lady's maid, she sets off to look for clues of Ned's whereabouts. But during her search, she comes across a mysterious man in hiding. Who is he and could he have something to do with Ned's disappearance? But the more Amy learns about this handsome stranger, the more perilous her world becomes. Especially after she falls in love with him...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: レディの冒険

215172.description:
Major Anthony Lyndhurst cannot believe his eyes. "There's no way that this is possible." But regardless, here before him in his own bedroom is his wife, Georgie, who disappeared without a trace four years earlier. After she disappeared, rumours spread that he had killed her, and Anthony was ostracized from high society. There's little chance of him forgiving her after that. Still, where has she been and what has she been doing these past four years? In the sequel to An Uncommon Abigail, the Lyndhursts' family drama gets darker, when secrets concerning the members and the disappearance of Anthony's young, estranged wife are uncovered.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 十九世紀の恋人たち　III

title.native: 舞い戻りし花嫁

215173.description:
When Cassie was very young, both her parents died and left her as the sole heir of a massive fortune. When she grew old enough to marry, numerous suitors lined up to court her in an effort to win her hand and fortune. Viscount Quinlan was one of them. Rumours abound that he has frittered away his own family's fortune through a lavish lifestyle, but Cassie's older cousin, Anthony, who has been her guardian since her parents passed away, told her that Quinlan is trustworthy and invites him to a party. But Cassie wants to find her own fiance and refuses Quinlan's advances, but she finds his kiss too powerful to further resist his charms...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 女相続人に求婚を
記憶のなかの愛
幸せの蜜の味
恋の訪れ

215177.description:
Lucy has traveled to Ramal Hamrah to chase her new husband, who stole all of her money right after their wedding. However, confused in this foreign desert land, she soon gets into a terrible car accident. Right before her car explodes, she's rescued by a stranger. When Lucy wakes up, she finds herself in the strong arms of a beautiful, angelic man. The man who saved her is Hanif, the prince of Ramal Hamrah. As he's volunteered to protect her in his palace!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 砂漠の天使

215178.description:
The stage is set with an unrivalled middle-aged man in a world overflowing with zombies…!
It’s been three years since he was first summoned to another world. Having the unique Class of “Samurai”, he defeated the Demon King along with his party of warriors: “Azami”, 38 years old.
When he finally makes it back to Japan, he comes to know that the world is now filled with zombies…?! Realizing that his skills acquired from the Other World remain intact, he sets out into the city to seek the truth and search for survivors.
From a hardware store to a school, through the city hall and the police station…. Using his magical powers for increased physical strength and strengthening his weapons, slashing through a sea of zombies on a motorcycle, what is it that awaits Azami…?!

(Source: Comic Nova, translated)
synonyms: A Middle-Aged Man Who Returned From Another World Becomes Unrivaled in the Apocalyptic World

title.native: 異世界還りのおっさんは終末世界で無双する
title.romaji: Isekaigaeri no Ossan wa Shuumatsu Sekai de Musou suru

215179.description:
Meguri Omoi is a beautiful and upright student council president. While she cannot tolerate any disruption to school discipline, she is secretly an otaku of the slightly risqué romantic comedy "Miracle☆Campus" (commonly known as "Mira☆Can")...! One day, Meguri encounters transfer student Kou Fukanose, and a sudden clash of interpretations regarding their beloved "Mira☆Can" erupts...!? An otaku with a secret she can't tell anyone, and a transfer student who knows more about "Mira☆Can" than anyone else—a new kind of mismatched comedy begins here!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ズレた解釈のぼくら

215180.description:
In the mansion on the hill, there lived two witches... It is the late 1980s—the twilight of an era of beauty and vigor. A boy moves to the city, barely missing two witches living in modern times. The boy leads a completely ordinary life. She carries herself with gallant pride. The girl lives a sleepy, hidden life. Each walks a starlit path. One would never expect their paths to cross. The story of how these three disparate people came together is soon to be told.

(Source: Steam)

title.native: 魔法使いの夜
新機動戦記ガンダムW × コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ　メヌエット・ゼロ
title.romaji: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing x Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch - Minuet Zero

title.native: いじめてくれる君がすき

215183.description:
Zenon Albanote, the Incubus King who stands at the very pinnacle of these demons, has reincarnated as a human in search of new "prey" (females). Over a decade has passed since then, and Zenon has already grown tired of the human women he has bedded. However, just when his boredom peaks, he receives an invitation from the Royal Lucetilia Academy of Magic, which has caught wind of his extraordinary talent. From noble young ladies to feisty, combative girls, the most promising young females gather at the greatest academy in the human world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生淫魔王のハーレム育成
救世の終末時計
たのしい音楽
禁断で禁断じゃないちょっと禁断な義兄妹ラブコメは未遂えっちから始まる。
title.romaji: Kindan de Kindan ja Nai Chotto Kindan na Gikei Imouto LoveCome wa Misui Ecchi kara Hajimaru

title.native: 八重乃遥可は8人いる!!

synonyms: Urban Myth Dissolution Center: Another Record

title.native: 都市伝説解体センター Another Record

215189.description:
It was the Taisho era... Amelie Haruzono, a cheerful and forward-looking girl with Western motherly features, attends an all-girls high school despite being subject to curious stares. However, one day, after a certain incident, Amelie begins to be attacked by yokai (monsters) as if drawn to her. She is saved by a mysterious military man named Akatsuki, but Akatsuki, driven by Amelie's blood, goes on a rampage. When Akatsuki, who is half yokai and half fox spirit, meets Amelie, he makes a "declaration" that she is already his bride...!? Why is Amelie being targeted by yokai? What is the secret organization "Domination" to which Akatsuki belongs? And what is the fate of the encounter between "the two"? A story that shakes the world of humans and yokai is about to begin!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

I was supposed to be just "me," but I was reincarnated into another world and became the villainess!? What's more, for some reason everyone loves me, and it's driving me crazy!? A sweet anthology depicting a wide variety of doting love!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

215194.description:
Yotsuya Tsubasa is not good at sports. Due to past trauma, she had lived a life unrelated to sports, but in high school, she dreams of joining a sports club, excelling, and becoming "someone confident enough to be admired." It is during club introductions that she becomes interested in archery. The action is simple: just shoot the arrow. She is excited, thinking she can do this too! But when things don't go as planned, Tsubasa becomes discouraged.

However, a single word uttered by Rikka Houraku, a classmate, changes Tsubasa's fate—a coming-of-age story of high school girls who dedicate themselves wholeheartedly to archery, like arrows flying straight through the air!

(Source: Hero's Inc, translated)

title.native: ソラノヤ

215195.description:
For Haruaki, a new nursery school teacher, Ms. Arima is a senior teacher. Ms. Arima is loved by the children, is reliable, and is respected, but she is also a huge horse racing fan. Haruaki has a crush on Ms. Arima and tries to get closer to her, but all Ms. Arima can think about is horse racing... This is a romantic comedy about a nursery school teacher who falls in love with a serious horse racing fan.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

215196.description:
Even though housewife Misaki didn't love the brusque attitude from her husband, Satoru, she still believed they were raising a happy family of three with her daughter, Megumi. However, one day, Misaki got in an accident and had to be hospitalized. Even while injured, her husband's cold attitude was a drastic difference from his friendliness towards the beautiful nurse. After being discharged, Misaki, injured and needed help to bathe, invites her husband to get in the bath with her for the first time in a long time. But for some reason, he absolutely refuses to take off his clothes...

(Source: Ichijinsha)

215197.description:
Kokoro Fukami was born with the ability to read other people’s minds. But after constantly seeing the gap between what people say and what they truly think, she has grown disgusted with others and unable to trust anyone. Then, a virgin boy suddenly appears before her. His thoughts are 100% driven by ulterior motives—and his emotions are just as painfully straightforward as everything else about him!? Though his shamelessly honest thoughts constantly leave her flustered, Kokoro begins to discover something she has never felt before: the comfort of being around someone with nothing to hide. Little by little, she starts to open her heart.

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)
synonyms: The Story of a Girl Who Can Read Minds

215199.description:
Brad Lester, once renowned as the strongest mage, vanished from the public eye after the tragic death of his young daughter. While living a quiet life as a lowly day laborer, his beloved wife is murdered by the "World Peace Promotion Association," an organization seeking his power. Driven by a despairing rage after losing everything, Brad sets out for revenge—only to find Valburga, the leader of the Association, has been transformed into a little girl?! Furthermore, she has lost her memories and has nowhere to go. Haunted by the memories of his late daughter, Brad resolves to "help his arch-nemesis regain her memories." Visiting the Olford Ancient Magic Research Institute, the mouse-worshipping town of Brooke, and the blizzard-shrouded village of Lutz, their long journey across the land begins—. An adventure fantasy of the strongest mage and his "child" companion!!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

215200.description:
In worlds where card games dominate everything, it's almost a cliché for the fate of the world to hang on the outcome of a card battle. I, Mitsuru Tanefuda, found myself reincarnated into such a world. Thankfully, my dream came true—I became the manager of my very own card shop.

In this world, people duel with cards, filled with joy and excitement, and I wanted to watch it all up close. But for some reason, everyone seems to think I'm some legendary hero who solved massive crises in the past, watching over the next generation like a noble predecessor. The truth is, I've never resolved any world-shaking incidents—not even once. This is the story of a reincarnated man who became the manager of a card shop in a world where card games take precedence over everything else. Despite having no great achievements to his name, everyone around him assumes he must have been a hero who once saved the world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Led by the talented but troubled Oh Hye-seong, the team struggles against their opponents while facing personal conflicts, social prejudice and their own painful pasts.

Ever since losing consciousness by the water as a child, Minho has been unable to forget the mysterious woman he met that day. Now an adult, he remains single, searching endlessly for someone who resembles her. Then one night, the woman of his dreams climbs into his room…

215207.description:
Yuki Amamiya is a highly regarded designer with a stable life. She has a good relationship with her husband and daughter, and they have a dog together. It’s a harmonious, picture-perfect family. She never harbored a single doubt about her family and believed this life would smoothly go on forever.

…Until that day, when she met Kai.

She was her daughter’s classmate — childlike in appearance, yet with words, actions, and a gaze that challenged even adults. But Yuki couldn’t ignore the occasional flashes of insecurity that were so typical for her age…

“I don’t mind you touching me, Yuki, but you're getting me all excited.”

“…You perverted brat.”

This is the story of a happily married woman who ends up doing XX with her daughter’s friend.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Everyone has a "ghost" in their hearts. It is a genuine feeling that is there but inexpressible. In this work, the girl Nike opposes the absurdity of the world in order to protect the "starry sky." This challenging work expresses Nike's solitude and heroism, and the subtleties of the heart as she interacts with others.

(Source: Bandai Namco Filmworks Press Release via Anime News Network)

Lesst, born between a noble and a commoner, is deemed to have “no magical power” during his magic aptitude test. In reality, however, he possesses an infinite amount of magical power.

Treated as a commoner and persecuted by his older brothers, Lesst resolves to become a court mage in order to prove his worth and show them what he is truly capable of.

Then, after a fateful incident, he catches the attention of the daughters of court mages, and his grand rise from the bottom begins.

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

Living in a dilapidated 50-year-old apartment with no bath and a shared toilet, and having lost her only family member, her mother, he was completely alone in the world when, after being hit by a truck, she suddenly found herself in the ideal room she had always dreamed of!

It seems I've been reincarnated into the body of a marquis's daughter, Sherry, from a different world than the one I lived in. Sherry is notorious as a villainess, so I thought it would be a bad omen, but then I exclaimed, "Is this my dream clawfoot bathtub!?" " So many dresses! They're so cute...!" Everything seemed insignificant compared to my dream!

This is the start of an indoor-themed fantasy comedy about striving for an even more ideal room life!

This is the origin story of the Snake-Woman, and also the fourth installment of the Yamabiko Shimai series.

Youko is a friend of Satsuki and Kanna. Her family is cursed since the time her grand-father injured a snake guardian spirit. After Youko's last relative is killed by a giant snake, a strange woman from a neighbor village adopts her, but somehow, Satsuki is worried about her friend.

215227.description:
In the near future, the full-dive VR game "Visions" is popular in Japan. However, the game has a flaw, and players who exploit it by staying logged in for extended periods are dying. An attempt is made to log all players out to stop the game, but some players rebel. In order to bring the players who have barricaded themselves in the game back to reality, the protagonist, Kokoro Hato, who works in the community welfare department's hikikomori (social withdrawal) countermeasures office, travels to the world of "Visions" and makes contact with the players...?

Miran Yata, a first year at Flower High School, is already barreling down the path to being a total loner not even two months into the school year! But she’s completely unbothered by this. Instead, she revels in her solitary youth and dedicates herself to drawing Boy’s Love (BL) art of the two popular guys in class—Nerima and Kirishima. Then, one fateful day, her BL notebook winds up in the hands of one of the very subjects himself, Nerima! Now outed, this loner girl’s high school life is turned completely upside down…!! And so begins this aloof (?) BL fangirl’s wild, high-energy coming-of-age tale!

(Source: K MANGA)

In a world of swords and magic, everyone is given a skill by Seriphynia, the Goddess of Skills. These skills cannot be chosen or changed, and they determine how people live their lives.

Gilvezos is the exception. Beloved by Seriphynia, he possesses a unique ability that allows him to turn his skills back into experience points and rebuild them into different ones.

With the Goddess of the Skill Tree at his side, Gilvezos can freely reconfigure his skills and create the most optimal skill set.

Thus begins the story of a goddess and the boy she has chosen, as they aim to create the ultimate skill build in another world.

One day, Yume Amagi, editor of the literary magazine "Gunsei," who wants to "bring a hot wind to the world of novels," is summoned by the editor-in-chief and told that he has a plan to launch a new literary magazine for the younger generation. Amagi becomes the "desk" in charge of the magazine, and in order to create the ideal lineup for the new literary magazine, he scrambles to gather writers! Amagi accompanies the "writers" - an actress, a musician, an ex-convict, a dairy farmer, and others - as they live their varied lives, suffer together, and strengthen their bonds. This ensemble drama of quietly passionate workers opens with a bang!

The horror story centers on cram school teacher Toshihiko Katayama, a stunningly handsome man, used to being the center of attention. One day, a woman with long black hair begins to stalk him, starts harassing Toshihiko's students and colleagues, and a strange phenomena attacks him. Toshihiko finally decides to visit a company that handles paranormal cases, owned by his friend from his school days, Rumi Sasaki.

Ataro, who lost his parents at a young age, has been running the greengrocer's shop since childhood, and Dekohachi, who has always admired Ataro and supported him. The two have grown into full-fledged young men, but they're causing a huge commotion again today, dragging the neighborhood boss and gang leaders into their mess! After reincarnating into the world of a video game, our protagonist realizes he has become Diablo, the most universally despised noble in existence. His impending fate? A gruesome and brutal revenge enacted by the game's very own heroines. Determined to atone for the original Diablo's heinous misdeeds, he resolves to save the women he once wronged. By overcoming harrowing trials and pushing past his absolute limits, he will claim the ultimate power and rewrite his tragic destiny!

Arga, who was expelled from the party he belonged to for the reason that he was "a Tamer, an unloved class," took this opportunity to have his level and such re-examined at the Adventurers' Guild, and there, he learned that he was a possessor of a second job that appears only once every thousand years. "Tamer," which makes monsters into allies, and "Fusionist," which combines and strengthens monsters - through these two jobs, Arga goes on to build the strongest party with monsters, the world's strongest female adventurer, and the vampire princesses!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

To escape the threat of the Demon King, the inhabitants of another world began summoning powerful individuals from other realms. Meanwhile, Song Yi-seok—an ordinary office worker—was summoned simply because he shared his name with South Korea’s greatest martial artist. Yet, the people of this new world mistook him for the ultimate hero! Amidst an adventure built on a misunderstanding, can he manage to defeat the Demon King while keeping his ordinariness a secret?

(Source: Naver, translated)
