“As expected of the Number One Sword Under Heaven. I cannot let you live.”

Baek Yang-Hwi finds himself on the verge of death after being ambushed. He still hadn’t managed to elevate his family into one of the great clans… It definitely happened that way.

“Did I really return to when I was eight years old?”

His family is third-rate, but his talent is the greatest in all of history. A life that has begun anew. This time, I will definitely turn my family into the greatest clan under heaven!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Third-rate Martial Family Becomes the Best Under Heaven
The World’s Strongest Is from a Third-Rate Martial Clan

title.native: 삼류무가 천하제일인

215259.description:
Your parents are dead because of you! It’s all your fault for being so damn selfish!

After losing her parents in a carriage accident, young Zoia grew up with those toxic words constantly beaten into her by her uncle’s family, saddling her with a profound sense of guilt. Stripped of her entire inheritance, the once-noble young lady was eventually reduced to a mere servant in her own family’s manor. Zoia reached adulthood completely alone, with no one to lean on and no one to protect her. As the unyielding despair crushed her spirit, she finally chose to end her own life.

But in the blink of an eye, fate threw her ten years back into the past. She woke up on the very day of her parents’ funeral. And there, sobbing uncontrollably beside the coffin, was—her younger self. Haunted by the tragedy awaiting her future, a dark thought crossed Zoia’s mind. If I just kill this little girl right now… that living hell will never happen. But the moment she looked into those tiny, tear-stained eyes, a sudden wave of memory flooded her chest. If only someone had reached out to save me back then… Right then and there, Zoia made her choice. No one had come to save her back then, but this time, she would rescue her past self with her own two hands.
synonyms: I Ended Up Raising My Younger Self
I Ended Up Raising My Child Self

title.native: 幼い自分を育てることになりました
title.romaji: Osanai Jibun wo Sodateru Koto ni Narimashita

215260.description: Hinata witnesses her stepmother’s affair and is pushed down a staircase. At the moment she thinks she has died, she suddenly finds herself reincarnated into the world of her favorite novel, “The Path to the Tyrant.” Worse yet, she has taken possession of the body of a villainous noblewoman who is destined to be killed by her favorite character, Yurieru. “Ah, so this is the typical bad-ending avoidance setup,” Hinata thinks. However, there is one problem—Yurieru has already realized that she is a reincarnated person! While Hinata continues to act the part of the villainess, unaware that she has been exposed, Yurieru pretends not to know anything. Though the two are drawn to each other, they both keep hiding their feelings. How long will it take for these two, unable to be honest with each other, to finally face their true feelings?
synonyms: I'm a Villainess Who Has Made an Enemy of the Tyrant, but I Will Turn Things Around!

title.native: 暴君を敵に回した悪女ですが、挽回させていただきます！
title.romaji: Boukun wo Teki ni Mawashita Akujo desu ga, Bankai Sasete Itadakimasu!

215261.description:
Sagahara-kun, a shoujo manga artist who uses his classmate Ogamida-san as a model, is always finding himself in embarrassing situations caused by her for some reason…!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: Ogamida-san Wants To See Your Blushing Face
Ogamida-san Wants to See His Pathetic Face

title.native: 拝田さんはヘタレ顔が見たい
title.romaji: Ogamida-san wa Hetare Gao ga Mitai

215262.description:
Kyouka, a beautiful college student and former idol, dotes on her childhood friend, the tomboyish Yuuri. Tonight, they're having a movie night at Yuuri's house! To surprise her, Kyouka sneaks into her room using her spare key, only to find... Yuuri live-streaming, professing her love for Kyouka!?

"Could it be that Yuuri likes me...?"

A love story between childhood friends, where their mutual unrequited feelings are unstoppable ♡

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title.native: 世界一可愛い私の幼馴染が 隠れてVTuberをしているらしい
title.romaji: Sekaiichi Kawaii Watashi no Osananajimi ga Kakurete VTuber wo Shite Irurashii

title.native: 나의 경험
落ちてるふたり

215265.description:
The noble house of Jeremias is no more. The family was forced to flee their home, bringing only a few belongings and their heir Chloe. She had nothing left after her parents both passed away. As far as she's concerned, there's only one man to blame: Marcel de Wintaire. With revenge in mind, she disguises herself and enters his service.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 107.

title.english: From Revenge Plots to Wedding Knots
title.native: 復讐に飢えた没落令嬢をメス堕ちするまで飼いならし、娶る。
title.romaji: Fukushuu ni Ueta Botsuraku Reijou wo Mesuochi suru made Kainarashi, Metoru.

title.native: これが私の秘密基地
title.romaji: Kore ga Watashi no Himitsu Kichi

title.native: ベストマッチング
Enjoy！スイミングレッスン

215269.description:
1. Tottemo Warui Ko; (とっても悪い子); Comic LO 2023-12
2. Enchou Lesson Kibou Shimasu!; (延長レッスン希望します!); Comic LO 2024-08
3. Futari no Omocha; (ふたりの玩具); Comic LO 2022-09
4. Watashi no Omocha; (わたしの玩具); Comic LO 2025-06
5. Hajimete no Idol; (はじめてのアイドル); Comic LO 2023-04
6. Sayonara, Papa; (さよなら、パパ); Comic LO 2022-05
7. Bukkake Iinchou; (ぶっかけ委員長); Comic LO 2022-02
8. JS Aesthetic: Remix; (JSエステ～Remix～); Original Doujinshi published in 2022-08

title.native: とっても悪い子
長身ボーイッシュ幼馴染みは抱かれたい

215271.description:
Cha Sang-Do, the adopted son and heir apparent of the Sangbaek Group, attempts to renounce his claim to the succession and leave the organization after the chairman’s death, but Yang-Jin, an employee at the host bar he used to manage, comes to see him, saying he has feelings for him. Although Sang-Do suspects Yang-Jin of being a spy for the organization and constantly insults him, he gradually opens his heart to Yang-Jin, who steadfastly refuses to leave his side, and eventually learns the secret between them that Yang-Jin had been hiding...

“You haven’t changed a bit, Sang-Do.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 보복의 날

215272.description:
Sang-Hun and Seo-Yun have been together since childhood. What began as friendship blossomed into love, and the two became a couple after graduation. However, unlike Seo-Yun, who, now that they’re a couple, wants to be closer than ever, Sang-Hun strangely avoids physical contact...

Seo-Yun feels hurt that Sang-Hun seems reluctant to deepen their relationship. One day, his pent-up frustration finally reaches a breaking point. Sang-Hun finally reveals the secret he had been hiding, even from Seo-Yun. But Seo-Yun’s reaction to Sang-Hun’s secret seems suspicious…?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 머리부터 발끝까지

215273.description:
Cha Do-Won, a genius national team member who knew nothing but shooting. From the very day he reunited with his first love, Seo Yi-Jeong, whom he hadn’t seen in nine years, he found himself having wet dreams about him...

The Yi-Jeong he met in his dreams was sensual and candid. But fearing he might never make the national team if things continued this way, Do-Won decided to seek out Yi-Jeong, whom he had been avoiding.

“Hyung, why did you kiss me?”

“I did it because I want to sleep with you.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 엑스텐
この恋はゴシップです
たぶん、恋色ブルー

215276.description:
On the morning of his high school entrance ceremony, Masato Kisaragi is reunited with his childhood friend and long-time crush, Yuurin Asazakura, who has just returned from studying abroad. Now that they’re attending the same high school, Masato finds himself caught up in Yuurin’s whirlwind personality, as she enjoys life back in Japan for the first time in a long time — even as his feelings for her only grow stronger. However, she already has a promised fiancé arranged by her parents, and that guy happens to be Masato’s “bro”…!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 夕凛ちゃんの忠犬くん

215277.description:
Eloise was born out of wedlock and raised in a frugal environment by her single mother. After her mother's death, she determinedly writes a letter to her father: the Viscount Pulborough. She asks him if he's ever spared her or her mother a second thought, but three weeks pass without a reply. One night, Eloise attends a work party and runs into the Viscount's stepson! He bluntly tells her that upper-class folks like him are used to gold diggers like her swarming around them...and that if she thinks she's squeezing any money out of him or his family, she's got another thing coming!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 封印された恋

215278.description:
Jordan Brodie: handsome, fun-loving, recently deceased. His former fianc?e, Laura Parkerson, is tasked with trying to sell off his paintings in her gallery, but Jordan's twin brother has other ideas, and as the executor of Jordan's will, he has a bit of say. Laura's pulled between his demands and those of his mother. She's too wrapped up in this family's arguments?does mother know best, or will her late fiance's doppelganger swing matters his way?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 悲しみに包まれて

215279.description:
On the verge of tears, personal assistant Taryn makes for the elevator. Just moments ago, she quit her job after her trusted boss kissed her in a moment of weakness. Never would Taryn have dreamed that the man she meets in the elevator would become her next boss. Jake Nash, CEO of industry leader Nash Corporation, hires her for a temporary secretary position with a promise not to mix love and work. It's a hard job, but Taryn is thrilled to be working at such a top- tier company. However, one day she has a sudden revelation: she's falling for her boss!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ボスには内緒

215280.description:
Fashion designer Ilana Girard is too busy with the next fashion contest to be worried about love, so when she meets Xandro Caramanis for the first time, she isn't distracted by his playboy actions. He relentlessly pursues her, though, and surprises her with a kiss. When the tabloids get a hold of the picture, rumors spread, and Ilana's stalker ex-fiance emerges to threaten her safety once again. Xando attempts to remedy the situation by protecting her, but can Ilana overcome her dark past? And what secrets does Xando hide behind his magnetic smile?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 忍び寄る悪夢

215281.description:
Robin lost her older brother Simon in a car accident, and a woman driving in the opposite lane was also killed. That woman's brother, Cesare, assumes that Simon was completely at fault for the accident and plans a clever, ruthless revenge: he uses his overwhelming economic power to force Robin into marrying him! Robin tries to fight the forced matrimony, but when that epitome of manliness Cesare pulls her into a rough kiss, all her strength leaves her body...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 復讐は大胆に

215282.description:
When a business deal to save Vivian's company goes south, she quickly becomes the drugged captive of Nicholas Rose... or is it Nicholas Thorne? She doesn't know if she's dealing with the sweet or sinister side of this pirate businessman, or if she was even his intended target. Is a disastrous car ride years ago the source of his vendetta, or has her beauty made her a target?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 愛という名の復讐
title.romaji: Ai to Iu Na no Fukushuu

215283.description:
Amagase Seiya, a girl with maxed-out "prince power," transfers into the all-boys boarding school "Golden Rose Academy" to protect the chastity of her childhood friend, Mikaboshi Raiki, who has become the "princess" of the boys' school. But right after enrolling, she catches the eye of the academy's most troublesome student...!? A lively, overly chaotic secret school life surrounded by handsome guys with all sorts of quirks is about to begin!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 秘密のいばら
処刑フラグ満載の嫌われ皇子のやり直し
title.romaji: Shokei Flag Mansai no Kiraware Ouji no Yarinaoshi

215285.description:
Romano Puccini, fashion designer and model: his handsome face and incredible talent drive women wild. Fashion magazine editor-in-chief Jackie, however, knows that Romano's charms are only an illusion. One summer they fell in love. That love should have lasted forever, but once Jackie revealed a certain secret, Romano turned his back and left her. She's avoided him ever since, but the two of them are reunited at her little sister's wedding. How dare he smile after the way he hurt her! Jackie has no reason to forgive him, so why does he still make her heart race?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ブライズメイドの秘密
孤独な救世主
公爵と私

215288.description:
Nicole, a designer, makes a living by redesigning vintage clothes at a flea market in Paris. Ever since a trusted friend stole her designs, she's kept her heart closed off to others. One day, she discovers that she's been chosen as the successor for Saint-Pierre, a huge brand with a longstanding history. Disaster strikes shortly after the announcement, but Sheik Rashid, a man famous for his work in the fashion industry, offers Nicole a helping hand when she needs it most.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A Sheik in the City of Love
title.native: シークは恋の都で
title.romaji: Sheikh wa Koi no Miyako de

215289.description:
Alice is a novice makeup artist until one day, Alex, the top commercial director in New York, selects her for a major job. Arrogant and ill-tempered, she doesn't get along with him at first. But when she sees how serious he is about his job, she becomes attracted to the kindness he shows. When they go to Hawaii on vacation, Alice becomes unable to resist his animalistic, dangerous charm, and the two cross the line.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 危険なライオン

215290.description:
To own the town saloon and mine, Lucas and Jackson MacIntyre need to get married within three months...or else they'll break that clause in their uncle Simon's will. Jackson has no desire for love, so it's up to Lucas to make their dreams come true. Luckily for them, schoolmarm Emily Smythe has found herself with no children to teach. She hopes that by marrying Lucas she'll be able to pursue her dreams of teaching those who missed out on an education. Could Emily be Lucas's convenient bride?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 魅惑の花嫁

215291.description:
In 19th century Paris, the city is ravaged by the sudden appearance of Albert Rolan, a handsome thief who steals from the ultra-wealthy in a spectacular and dramatic fashion and gives the riches to the poor. A young aristocrat's daughter named Rose gets caught up in his affairs and ends up getting kidnapped by the thief after trying to stop him from stealing the Rosario, her family's treasured heirloom. But among other things, has the thief also stolen...her heart? Find out this and more in the exciting first volume of the "Romancing the Thief" series, an epic love story filled with hidden treasures!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 宿命のロザリオ

215292.description:
Rowena is a dutiful wife to Phil, and a lovely mother to three kids. But her beautiful life quickly comes crashing down when Phil runs off with Adrianna, a secretary at the company he works for. When Rowena demands to meet her at work, she encounters Kier Delahunty, head of the company and a fling of hers from a decade ago. Does Rowena still want to fight for Phil's affection, or is Kier the one who can complete her family?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 再会のクリスマスから

215293.description:
Tiana, a marquise's daughter, and Crown Prince Lagiras, who loved each other and vowed to remain pure until marriage, suddenly break off their engagement one day when Lagiras announces he will marry Tiana's cousin, Serage!? Three years have passed since her beloved fiancé and her close cousin married and became king and queen after the betrayal. Tiana, who lives quietly in her rural territory, receives a summons from the royal court! Filled with anger at the thought of being betrayed and now being summoned, she goes to the royal castle only to be told by the prime minister to become Lagiras's "childbearing partner"!? She thought she had no desire to be with her ex-fiancé, with whom her relationship was over—.

(Source: Shusuisha, translated)

title.native: 私を振った人の子作り相手に命ぜられました
title.romaji: Watashi wo Futta Hito no Kozukuri Aite ni Meizeraremashita

215294.description:
Broken engagement, misunderstanding, betrayal—a lady of high society won't back down so easily.

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title.native: 不幸令嬢は復讐もハッピーエンドも成し遂げる アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Fukou Reijou wa Fukushuu mo Happy End mo Nashitogeru! Anthology Comic

215295.description:
Scarlet, an esthetician, had to go to a film studio to do a wardrobe fitting on behalf of her twin sister. That's when she reunited with Hollywood star Gray. People say he's cool and sexy, but her impression of him is arrogant and mean. The next day, Gray suddenly showed up at her workplace and she was forced to go with him to his house. Is this the start of a secret love? The story of Scarlet's twin sister, Violet, titled How to be a Heroine of Love, is also in this collection!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: How to Fall in Love With a Hollywood Star
title.native: ハリウッドスターと恋する方法

215296.description:
Years ago, Rose-Anitra left her home country of Alp D'Montez amidst claims she was an illegitimate heir to the throne. HerA bucolic life as a married veteran is shattered when her husband is quickly ravaged by cancer. Newly widowed, she's sought out by an older assistant to the throne. Alp D'Montez needs fresh blood and bold tactics to stay afloat, but the plan to save her homeland involves her marrying Prince Nikolai. Can Rose help save a country while protecting her heart?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: プリンセスはひとりぼっち

215299.description:
Female detective Saeka Suzumoto is working tirelessly to catch the notorious "Akasagi" (Red Heron) Rentaro Soyogi, who has been causing a stir in the public. As she investigates the cases of the women who have been victimized, she begins to take an interest in the mysterious man "Soyogi," going beyond the confines of her duties as a detective.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 赤の結婚
ZABAAAN

synonyms: God Says She Wants to Take My Picture!

title.native: 神は私を撮りたいって言ってます!
title.romaji: Kami wa Watashi wo Toritai tte Ittemasu!

215302.description:
It was the early Showa era. In the mountains of the Hokkoku region, a town nicknamed "Cat Town" was gripped by terror due to a series of brutal cat killings! Amidst this, a case is brought to Mayoiji Somari, who runs a small detective agency in a corner of this town. The client is Saiberian, along with Amemiya Shota from the Cat Town Police Department's First Investigation Division, a poet named Sakutaro staying at the "Blue Cat Inn" hotel, and a suspicious cat named Tatsuishi Rii. Can Detective Somari, whose only strengths are her athleticism and sense of justice, get closer to the truth of the case!?

(Source: Comipo, translated)

title.native: ネコたん！～猫町怪異奇譚～

215303.description: An unofficial Persona-themed yonkoma fan manga released on Twitter. This series is based on Persona 3 Reload and Persona 4 Revival.

title.native: タルタロス劇場
セコカン！
華ちゃんはヌいてくれる

215306.description:
To recover from the events with the Snake-Woman, Yumiko is sent into the mountains to visit her cousin Kyouko. But at her arrival at the village, the people are afraid of Yumiko, saying that she is the Snake-Woman!

Note: This version was published as a supplemental volume for Nakayoshi magazine.
synonyms: まだらの少女　総集編

title.native: まだらの少女
地上最強の公務員 リストラ代紋
title.romaji: Chijou Saikyou no Koumuin: Ristora Daimon

215308.description:
Europe during World War I. Pan, a man striving to achieve more victories than anyone else for the sake of his ailing wife, nearly loses his life. Appearing before him is Cerberus, a dog claiming to be the "world's guardian dog." After saving Pan from peril, Cerberus asks him to defeat Echo, an extraordinary being that distorts world history…

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

title.native: ドッグ・タイムズ

215309.description:
Yumiko's mother is hospitalized. But after being discharged, the mother is acting strange, she quickly reveals to be the Snake-Woman, and she wants to devour the poor Yumiko!

Note: This version was published as a supplemental volume for Nakayoshi magazine.

title.native: ママがこわい

215310.description:
A young lady with no luck with men...? But she'll definitely be happy!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title.native: 男運は無かったけれど最後に幸せになるのは私ですわ! アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Otokoun wa Makatta keredo Saigo ni Shiawase ni Naru no wa Watakushi desu wa! Anthology Comic

215311.description:
Published as a supplemental volume for the manga magazine Nakayoshi, this includes three alternative versions of previously published stories by Kazuo Umezu.

1. Noroi no Men (のろいの面)
2. Akai Fuku no Shoujo (赤い服の少女)
3. Kitsune ga Kureta Ki no Happa (狐がくれた木の葉っぱ)

title.native: 楳図かずお先生の…こわいまんが特集
title.romaji: Umezu Kazuo-sensei no... Kowai Manga Tokushuu

title.native: おかえり、私を汚すα

215313.description: A young comedian is struggling to make jokes because of his serious nature, until one day his life changes when he steps into the world of professional wrestling.

title.native: GREEN BOY

215314.description:
The Demon Lord suddenly appeared in Saitama. Three descendants of heroes (a girl, a boy, and an old man) reluctantly (?) rise up to defeat the Demon King who has been resurrected to destroy the world. The heroes' only weapon is "delicious Japanese food." They must keep their stomachs full to curb the Demon Lord's destructive impulses!

(Source: Hero's Inc, translated)

title.native: 魔王様、世界が美味しすぎて滅ぼすのをやめる。
title.romaji: Maou-sama, Sekai ga Oishi Sugite Horobosu no Oyameru.

215315.description: The story begins in a small village west of the capital and centers on childhood friends Yuugo and Tenia. While Yuugo focuses on being an herbalist, Tenia is a hunter. A force of Arisen knights passes through their town in search of more Arisen to join their ranks. Tenia reveals that she is an Arisen and wants to travel with them.

title.native: ラゴンズドグマ リヴァイブス
花音ちゃん、恋のお仕事です！

215317.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 August issue.

title.native: 冬の終わりに春を待つ
title.romaji: Fuyu no Owari ni Haru wo Matsu

title.native: トライアウト・セックス
持ちつ持たれつ甘やかされて

215320.description: Note: Published in Weekly Young Jump No. 36/37.

title.native: 小僧ねずみのちゅちゅのすけ

215321.description:
Long ago, the "fairies" who once existed vanished, leaving behind only fossils known as "Wands". Those capable of wielding the power hidden within these Wands came to be known as "Fairy Users." In a world where humans and Fairy Users coexist, Arata lives a bitter life, treated as an outcast. One day, a mysterious and melancholic girl named Misa appears before him. Their encounter sets their lives in motion, leading to an adventure bound for the "Fairy Graveyard", a legendary land where countless Wands lie dormant! So begins an epic tale of battle, fantasy, and exploration!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: ワンダラスト

215322.description:
Find solace in stories of freshly baked goods. This collection features works by nine artists on the theme of "bread."

An extra-girly dream bakery. A bread party on a farewell day. A tour of German bread. With bread, every day is a little happier.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: パンが大好き コミック&イラストアンソロジー
title.romaji: Pan ga Daisuki: Comic & Illustration Anthology

215323.description:
High school teacher Haruo Nemoto is seen as a dull, taciturn outcast at his school. Yet deep down, he cares for his students more than anyone else, a man of principle who just wants their youth to shine. But he has a secret: under certain conditions, he can make himself invisible. Armed with “that ecchi trope that all guys know about,” he will rise to the challenge every day to protect his students!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ハルスケル

215324.description:
A tragedy that repeats itself in broad daylight! And finally, the shocking conclusion! What will become of the terrifying mummy and the girls…?! A masterpiece of school horror that caused a sensation when it was serialized in magazines. This volume includes the concluding chapter, as well as 4-Nenme ga Kowai (4年めがこわい) and Noroi no Men (のろいの面).

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 続ミイラ先生

215325.description:
Jia's assigned a mission: write a strategy guide for the newest dating simulation game. Easy enough, or so she thought. But this hardcore game only has bad endings, and every sensation is felt, pain or pleasure. It's... a dream come true! Can Jia survive the game and get her Merry Bad Ending?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: A Guide to a Merry Bad Ending
Strategy Guide for a Merry Bad Ending

title.english: Strategy Guide for a Merry Bad Ending
title.native: 메리 배드 엔딩을 위한 공략집

215326.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Bimil Danpyeonseon (비밀 단편선) Collection.

title.native: 바이브레이션

215327.description: Note: Originally self-published on the author's Postype. Published by Ridibooks on 2026-08-02.

title.native: 왜곡된 사랑

215328.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Saek-ya Short Story Collection] A Villain Abused by a Hero

title.native: 히어로에게 당하는 빌런
내 남자친구는 낙서장

215330.description:
Perla's husband, who tormented her with lies and treachery, had just died, and for one night she wanted to forget everything. She met a man at a bar and gave him her virginity, something her husband never wanted. They spent a passionate evening together and forgot all their worries-they didn't even tell one another who they were. Eventually, Perla realizes that the man, Arion, is a Greek millionaire and an executive at the company where her husband was employed. They reunite at his funeral, both dressed for mourning...but perhaps Perla will find joy again one day.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 喪服の愛人

215331.description:
Laurel Midland harbors a dark secret, one that leads her to think she deserves no happiness in life. When she arrives at the house of widower Charles Gray, she finds a like-minded soul in a child who's been denied much happiness. As the new nanny, she's tasked with proving herself to Charles, proving that you need to have fun to live, and learning that you need to forgive yourself to move on.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 未来への扉

215332.description:
What a day! First Grace's boss makes her buy sexy lingerie for his girlfriend, then a passing car soaks her in mud and now the pricy lingerie she was carrying is completely ruined. There's no way she can replace it on her salary. Thankfully, a beautiful man gets out of the offending car and promises to pay for any damages, so she has nothing to worry about. But Grace gasps when she realizes who he is-just what is her boss's rival, Maksim Rostov, doing here?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: モスクワの夜は熱く

215333.description:
We first met in high school. He was a rough,taciturn boy,yet everyone looked to him for leadership. I was a plain-Jane honors student with braces. Coincidence brought us back together again. Now,he's a big name in finance-any woman would want him-while I'm a widow who's lost my savings,my job and my house-not to mention I'm pregnant! Ryan was kind enough to hire me as a home tutor for his daughter,but I doubt he has any idea how much his generosity has affected me. (The Millionaire's Nanny Arrangement) Bedded by Blackmail also included.

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 幸せの青い蝶
とっても悪い子

バリキャリJKモネ先輩

延長レッスン希望します!
キオ先輩はクズだしドM
わたしの玩具
はじめてのアイドル
みんなの優ちゃん♥
陰キャ少女は断れない
となりの不良少女を助けたらいっぱいHな事させてくれた話
title.romaji: Tonari no Furyou Shoujo wo Tasuketara Ippai H na Koto Sasete Kureta Hanashi

title.native: コールミー・バイ・ノーネーム

215346.description:
Evie is one of the best psychics in New Orleans. One day, an unexpected visitor comes to see her-Jack Murphy, a detective and a former lover of Evie's. Their relationship fell apart due to a terrible misunderstanding, and now they despise each other. Despite all that, Jack asks Evie for help. He wants her to get close to the wife of casino owner MacDougal and find evidence of his illegal activities. Evie has no choice but to cooperate, although she knows it's a risky job. No one can resist the alluring Jack Murphy.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 占えない明日

215347.description:
Andrew has an important goal in mind: he needs to get married so he can take over the family law firm. Kat has an equally important desire: she needs to find a father for the child she wants to have-but it has to be a man she has no chance of falling in love with. They can combine forces to attain their own personal goals-but can they keep their marriage purely contractual?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 理想の花婿？

215348.description:
Jake D'Amato is a wealthy businessman with an eye for the art world. He feels compelled to buy a painting by the late Robert Summerville-of a model rumored to be the artist's lover. Who is this mysterious woman? Did she have a relationship with Robert? More curiously, did she also have a relationship with Jake? It wouldn't be a problem except Jake is falling in love with Robert's daughter, Charlotte. Can an international fling be tossed to the wind when an unexpected pregnancy is painted into the picture?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 復讐とは気づかずに

215349.description:
The moment she first saw her best friend's fiance, Tom, Sylvie could feel her heart rate rising. She quells those feelings and focuses on preparing her friend's wedding as the professional event planner that she is, but then the bride disappears right before the wedding! Sylvie ends up spending a passionate night with Tom, to comfort him during his time of loss. She then sends him a letter telling him that she's pregnant with his child, but when she doesn't hear back from him, Sylvie feels betrayed and unwanted. What are the chances that they'd be reunited by a magazine project to design her "dream wedding,"which lands her in the role of the bride and him as the groom?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: すみれ色のウエディング

215350.description:
Gail has been ordered to act as a corporate spy. She doesn't want to do it, but if she doesn't, her company will be bought out and her coworkers will be sacked. It's all up to her. What is worse, her target is her high school love, Zane Lorenson! It was a one-sided love, and she ended up being cruelly hurt. She doesn't want to see him again, but now she has no choice but to work beside him as his secretary...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ボスと秘書の休日

215351.description:
Because of her little brother's gambling addiction, young Catherine now finds herself shouldering a five-thousand-pound debt. A nurse advises her that if she were to marry a death-row inmate the debt would be absolved, and that it would be better than becoming the mistress of an old nobleman. With no other options left, she goes to the prison. She actually follows through and ends up marrying an unshaven, scary-looking man named Jack. Jack's infamous in town because he's a known boss in the criminal underworld. During their wedding night, Jack's freed from his shackles and allowed some freedom to tidy himself up. He suddenly transforms into an impeccably mannered and handsome young man! Not exactly what Catherine was expecting...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 花嫁は絶体絶命

215352.description:
It's Summer's first day meeting her boss, Phin Gibson. The ever-diligent Summer is nervous about meeting him and comes to the office bright and early, only to have Phin show up late, looking like he'd just rolled out of bed definitely not the look of the executive of a big corporation! The truth is there's not a person in the U.K. who doesn't know who he is. He's the younger brother of the head of a major department store chain, but also stars in his own nature show where he explores deserts and jungles. In fact, he has no interest in the company. Sure, he may be handsome, but he's also completely childish. The exact opposite everything Summer had been expecting. But will her initial impression give way to something more?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 秘書の失恋日記

215353.description:
Petrakos Industries is Greece's international maritime transportation company. The manager, Janis Petrakos, is well known for his ruthless competence in the industry. He's also the secret crush of Maddy, a temporary employee in his home. Things don't look like they're going well for Maddy. When she makes a huge mistake at an important meeting, she incurs his wrath. Later, she goes to his room, with the intent of apologizing, only to find him waiting for her half-clad and still wet from a shower. He has a beautiful , upper-class fiancee! But...he's the object of her desires, as well! Can she resist his coercive temptation? What will happen if she gives in to him?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 伝説の恋人

215354.description:
The manga centers on Lucia Stearon, a princess who possesses a special physical characteristic that transforms her bodily fluids into "jewels." Lucia has dedicated her sweat, tears, and even blood to her country since she was a child. But on the night of her wedding, she is poisoned by none other than the prince she married. Lucia miraculously wakes up, but finds herself back in time six months before her wedding.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 死に戻りの宝石姫は、二度目の人生を謳歌する。
title.romaji: Shi ni Modori no Houseki Hime wa Nidome no Jinsei wo Ouka suru.

215355.description:
Young detective Mugen Mamiya finds himself forced to tackle a case while cleaning up the mess left by a diabolical doctor’s outrageous, insane inventions! He faces these challenges alongside the super-strong Alucard and the all-purpose robot Agatha II. This long-awaited latest volume in the series blends the edginess of the adult Mamiya with the humor of the younger Mamiya!

(Source: Hayakawa Shobou, translated)

title.native: 夢幻紳士 猟奇篇

215356.description:
As a young girl, Wanseo survived her illness by eating the Queen Mother's sacred peach. However, her body gained a tempting peach scent that made her a target for evil spirits. While Wanseo's father is away seeking the Jade Emperor's advice on the matter, he leaves her under the protection of Baek Ho, the handsome fox spirit she has unrequited feelings for. After an incident draws them closer, Ho grows aware of his attraction to Wanseo. But what will happen to their budding romance when the emperor advises Wanseo to marry one of the spirits on his list for her safety...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 여우 신랑

215357.description:
All her life, our heroine hid in the shadows just to avoid being disliked. After an untimely death, she now wakes up as Anneliese, the loathed villainess of a simulator game who is doomed to die. Desperate to survive and find genuine love, she tries to defy the original storyline. Nothing works until Helmut, the dark and unplayable fallen duke, enters the scene. Helmut was never meant to love anyone, yet his intense fixation on Anneliese changes everything.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

215363.description:
The legendary fragrance "White Night Fragrance" is said to be born from the sap of the "Tree of the Gods." A sculptor named Guan, having heard rumors of its existence, devises a plan to steal the tree for a certain purpose. As he carves legs and a mouth for transport, and communicates with the tree, it gradually develops a will of its own…

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

215373.description:
Seven years before a certain boy will arrive in the Labyrinth City, an era of chaos and strife reigns supreme. Ryu Leon spends her days serving the goddess Astrea while searching for a brand of justice she can believe in. She's not alone, for the rest of Astrea Familia are a rare source of light in these dark times. In the shadows, however, something evil is stirring—a threat that will shake Orario to its very foundations…!

(Source: Yen Press)

215375.description:
Born into a family of priests, Lydia was ostracized by her family for being born without magical powers, treated as an unwanted child. After her engagement was broken off, she ran away from home and opened a diner called "Lobelia" to start a new life! Traumatized by her painful past, she cooks with resentment and bitterness. But for some reason, Lydia's cooking becomes incredibly popular, with everyone calling it "healing food"!?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title.native: 大衆食堂悪役令嬢　～婚約破棄されたので食堂を開いたら癒やしの力が開花しました～
title.romaji: Taishuu Shokudou Akuyaku Reijou: Konyaku Haki saretanode Shokudou wo Aitara Iyashi no Chikara ga Kaika shimashita

215376.description:
In postwar Japan, a time when many people, hungry for printed words, formed long lines at bookstores, Tsubame Takanashi, a rookie editor at the small literary publishing house Nekorobido, is tasked with collecting the manuscript from the notoriously eccentric novelist, Nero Uguisudani. Tsubame eagerly visits Uguisudani's home, only to find that he refuses to hand over the manuscript unless he immediately buys him his favorite sweets. Thinking his skills as an editor are being put to the test, Tsubame eagerly heads to Ginza. However, this is merely Uguisudani's flimsy excuse to extend the deadline...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 文豪のおやつ

215377.description:
Aragaki Kuuya was involved in a maritime accident when he was 8 years old and was transported to another world. That other world, which at first glance seemed peaceful, was actually a world where the countdown to destruction had just begun. It was a world where men suddenly transformed into monsters called Renma! Kuya is at a loss when his master, who guided and raised him as a child, finally turns into a demon. Then, a ship carrying a young girl drifts ashore from a neighboring continent—!? The last man left in the world can change a world on the brink of destruction!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

215379.description:
Jeongchan has long been in love with his best friend's mother. Although his first confession is rejected, she gives him one condition if he wants to confess again: he must experience other kinds of love first. And so, Jeongchan becomes involved with women of vastly different charms, encountering the many faces of love, desire, and devotion along the way...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

215382.description:
Akina's engagement to Sosuke, arranged by their parents, was broken off when her parents' company went bankrupt. Originally a strong-willed and independent woman, Akina worked enthusiastically at the company she earned through her own efforts, despite the hardships. However, her former fiancé, Sosuke, was now an executive at the company that was acquired by her former fiancé. Despite his cold and distant demeanor, he couldn't hide his affection for Akina... This is a love story of misunderstandings between a strong-willed woman and a tsundere man.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 素直じゃないのはハートのせい
title.romaji: Sunao ja nai no wa Heart no Sei

215383.description:
Shin Seryeong thought her life was over when her husband succumbed to illness, leaving her blamed for his death and cast out as a barren widow. Isolated at the outskirts of town, she expects nothing more from life than solitary endurance. That changes the day Kwon Seohan enters her life. Unlike the rest of the village, Seohan is drawn to her, his interest flaring even brighter upon learning of her tragic past. Unable to pull back from his hypnotic charm, Seryeong is swept into a dangerous world of passion, left wondering whether Seohan is her long-awaited salvation or her final undoing.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: รอยรักฝืนลิขิต

title.native: 파금

215384.description:
Reiko, the former daughter of a company president, finds herself poor after her family's downfall. She works odd jobs, but she has one little pleasure: every payday, she can indulge in one luxurious gourmet dish within her budget. A hilarious gourmet comedy about a fleeting dream with high-end ingredients costing under 5000 yen!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 没落麗子のシンデレラグルメ

215385.description:
A corpse lies at the bottom of the cliff before us. It's clear someone on this island committed the murder, but none of the eight people involved are willing to move. "While we're on this island, we must never find the killer." That was the "commandment" imposed upon us. A shocking new work from the author of "The Ark"!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 十戒

215386.description:
"I've come to get my wife." On the day of the wedding, the groom, Koumei Oh, showed up soaked in blood. The bride, Meirin, couldn't hide her horror at the sight. The Oh family, a military family, has been cursed to die by the age of 30 due to their violent acts in battle. In this age, doctors have lost their position in society and the Xian have been entrusted to save people. The emperor, hearing rumors that "those who make a vow with a Xian and produce descendants shall never perish," arranged for Koumei to marry Meirin, a Xian. However, Meirin doesn't actually possess the powers of the Xian and is marrying Koumei in place of her older sister, Shenrin. Meirin fears she may be killed if this lie is discovered, but Koumei turns out to be different from the rumors, and Meirin begins to fall in love...

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)
synonyms: God of War and False Bride

title.native: 軍神と偽りの花嫁
逆行した元悪役令嬢、性格の悪さは直さず処刑エンド回避します！

title.native: いっぱいおかえり

215389.description:
The Kingdom of Elbert once prospered thanks to the blessings of the spirits and the efforts of the Saintess. --Some time has passed, and the Saintess is nowhere to be seen in the temple where the spirits are worshipped. In her place is Sylphia, the "figurehead saintess." Imprisoned in the temple and oppressed by the real saintess, she diligently serves as the saintess's substitute... Then one day, the spirits suddenly appear before her--!?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title.native: お飾り聖女のはずが、真の力に目覚めたようです THE COMIC
title.romaji: Okazari Seijo no Hazu ga, Shin no Chikara ni Mezameta You desu THE COMIC

215390.description:
"I just want to be someone's special person." With this single-minded desire, high school girl Torami aims to become an idol. One day, she comes to the rescue of her classmate Yoko, who is being bullied in the bathroom. The two girls, each carrying their own loneliness, quickly become best friends... But Torami's painfully pure wish attracts a violent man named Takagi, and her life is turned upside down. To escape this curse, they must go to any lengths together.

A coming-of-age suspense story that is beautiful precisely because it is fleeting.

(Source: Live Comics, translated)

title.native: 虎と羊

215393.description:
"I can finally touch you. I've been waiting for this moment for so long." Six sweet and melting one-shot TL stories with the Duke everyone dreams of ♥

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.romaji: Akogare no Koushaku-sama ni Totsuidara, Shuuchaku H ga Tomarimasen! Anthology

215394.description:
Haku, a boy who aspires to be a novelist, meets Jin, a man who stood up to change the country "core flower" that lays down the tyranny. I am convinced that Jin, who is thick in honor, has excellent martial arts, and looks to the future strongly, is the hero that Haku pursues in the novel - the hero. In order to defeat the core flower, Haku acts with Hitoshi who tries to obtain the weapon "Shinsenpo" of the sennin created by Sennin, and his heart is excited at the beginning of the poignant revolutionary story ...! Justice and justice compete for the victory fantasy huge edition, opening!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

みらいいろ〜だいすきないろ〜
都市伝説清掃員

215397.description:
The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 君と花火と約束と@comic
title.romaji: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to @comic

215398.description:
The story is set in a world where heroes are part of various companies, taking down villains plotting ruin on the world. The story begins with protagonist Kakeru Ginga, Japan's best player of a hobby game called "Ultra Menko." As a child, his skill in the game put him in the limelight, but 10 years later, he works a normal job and longs to be a hero. When he meets a genius named Dengaru, it awakens his old passion and the drive within him to become a hero.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 超限マーケットヒーローズ　メンコリバーサーカケル

215399.description:
18th-century London. Robert, a boy with heterochromia (different colored eyes), encounters a strange man who claims to dissect corpses and "bury a map of the human body." But what is this man after? Robert's eyes! The story of John Hunter, the anatomist who is said to have laid the foundation for modern medicine, begins!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)
synonyms: The Mystery of Modern Medicine John Hunter

title.native: レザレクション-近代医学の怪人ジョン・ハンター-
title.romaji: Resurrection: Kindai Igaku no Kaijin John Hunter

215400.description:
In order to find out the strength of the earth, the alien Xi Guang went undercover on the earth as a student. He mistakenly believed that the science fiction-themed comics and movies on Earth were a display of Earthlings’ capabilities in simulating interstellar warfare, so he resolutely joined the school animation club. Because of the generation gap between aliens and earthlings, a series of hilarious incidents occurred…Xi Guang’s undercover life, which seemed to endure humiliation but was actually ridiculous, was unfolding all the time!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 光临地球
教室が、ひとりになるまで
title.romaji: Kyoushitsu ga, Hitori ni Naru made

215402.description:
In a turbulent era where numerous nations divided the world, a small country was conquered and destroyed by an ambitious warlord, and a young boy was taken prisoner. But the boy did not give up... he vowed to one day save his people from the warlord's clutches. To that end, the boy aspired to become a being with supernatural powers, a "sage"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 千仙戦記

215403.description:
A legendary mercenary, once feared as a killing machine on the battlefield, has arrived in Japan. He has taken on a new name: Ryuusei Nogawa. His mission is "to raise a baby." But Nogawa, who has never known a peaceful, quiet life, is struggling mightily with parenting for the first time!? To ensure the healthy growth of the mischievous Hoshina-chan, he must "legally" eliminate any dangers that come his way! A slice-of-life parenting story featuring the former strongest mercenary!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: キラーシッター

215404.description:
Reincarnated into a world where everyone gets one divine skill, Victor draws the short straw with “Poison Immunity.” Deemed a failure compared to his “Sword Saint” little brother, he’s kicked out of his noble house. At least it’s better than being a puppet for his scumbag father, right? But when a cliffside monster attack leaves him staring death in the face, Victor makes a reckless choice: he eats toxic monster meat.

Instead of killing him, something else happens…

“Skill: Heaven Sunder Acquired!”

Turns out, “Poison Immunity” lets Victor absorb the traits and abilities of any monster he eats! Shattering the laws of “one skill per person”, the more he eats, the more unstoppable he becomes—one monster meal at a time!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: After Getting the Crap Skill "Poison Immunity," I Ate the Toxic Meat of a Dead SSS-Rank Monster and Awakened an OP Ability

215405.description:
Background character Yoyo Yee has always helped others shine -- until her million-sub YouTuber first love, Hugh Leung, opens an audition that could finally put her in the spotlight. With sharp-tongued friend Jimmy Tang by her side, Yoyo dives into the brutal world of content creation. But between self-doubt, jealous rivals, and old feelings she can’t ignore, can she survive the competition and become the leading lady in her own story? A story about chasing impossible dreams and finding the courage to believe in yourself.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hazel Love possessed the body of a character destined to die from overwork, but she defied her fate, quit her job, and established a guild to make a name for herself. Determined to reinvent herself and emulate Eiji, Kitori doubles down on her routine with Takumi, taking bold steps toward a new version of herself—

Desperate, Fall sets out on an adventure alone to make a living, but unfortunately encounters a dragon. He's hit by its breath and seems to die instantly—but he's unharmed!? Fall has acquired the strongest body by continuing to absorb everyone's debuffs! An encounter with a beautiful heroine who can't pull out the holy sword, battles against the Demon Lord's army... amidst the turmoil, Fall grows even stronger. Meanwhile, his party members keep failing quests in the face of unfamiliar debuffs... When their skills work together, they're unstoppable!

As the samurai navigates this new world, he encounters various creatures and people, including goblins, guild masters, and nobles. Despite his initial skepticism, the samurai learns about the existence of magic, dungeons, and different races that inhabit the world. Along the way, he finds himself questioning his principles and values, and whether they can remain unchanged in this fantastical world.
Will he be able to maintain his strict adherence to his bushido code? Or will the temptations of this foreign world lead him astray? "I've finally found you, my love—" Chiyo, the daughter of the Mizunoe family, endures daily torment and comparison to her younger sister. Finally, she is offered as a sacrifice to a dragon. Just as she accepts her fate, she is saved by a beautiful man— A doting love fantasy unfolds as a sacrificial girl is noticed by a solitary commander!

(Source: Flex Comics, translated)

title.native: 龍の巫女の嫁入り～いらないほうの娘、つがいの帝国総司令に溺愛される～

215746.description:
All I needed in my life was a moderate amount of work and money. That's all I thought. Kiyoko Tono, a section chief, was living a frugal, single life far removed from romance due to certain circumstances. While comforting her subordinates who were being put through the wringer by the handsome but strict department head, Yukisada, Kiyoko felt Yukisada's clumsy kindness. One day, the apartment building where Kiyoko lived was accidentally demolished!? The new owner turned out to be department head Yukisada... "Why don't you stay with me until you find a new place?" A cohabitation romance between a handsome, cool boss and a caring single woman!

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)

215747.description:
As an administrative public health nurse, newcomer Sango conducts medical and health-related activities and social welfare activities for everyone from infants to the elderly living in the community. Sango's on-the-job supervisor, Sayaka Nanami, is apparently a former yankee, but her advice is always spot on. Nanami's favorite phrase is, "I won't leave anyone out". Under the strict watchful eye of her mentor, Sango works with her to solve problems such as mothers who are worried about raising children and single men with metabolic syndrome. Sango's tenacity and perseverance are the focus of this work!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Seizo Watase’s lighthearted detective story, presented in full color. While Philip is playing pinball as usual at G’s shop, a client pays him a visit. Just like Philip, who likes to act like a hard-boiled detective, Lady Ingrid—who loves hard-boiled stories—asks Philip to help her find her heart, which was stolen by Mr. Fried from Kentucky…

(Source: Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha, translated)

215751.description:
One day, a pet cat and dog named Buchi and Kotaro wake up to find that they have become yokai, supernatural beings blessed with eternal life. Now, not only do they get to spend more time with their beloved owner, they can stick around to befriend his children, and his children's children! But even as Buchi and Kotaro remain the same, their owner slowly begins to gray...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

215754.description:
Jiang Yan, wielder of a god-tier modification skill, was exploited until he had nothing left, only to perish during a demonic beast invasion.

Filled with resentment, he is reborn…returning to the time before his Class Awakening!

This time, he will keep a low profile and grow his power in secret.

He won’t just defy his fate; he will save the entire world from the impending Abyssal invasion!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Betrayed and left for dead by his own teammates, Bu Jin is reborn, fueled by a burning resentment!

This time, he will restore the glory of the Bu family and exact vengeance on the bastards from his past life! Furthermore, he aims to become the one and only SSS-Rank God of War in “The World of Nine.”

His legendary, overpowered journey begins now!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

215756.description:
Ye Tianji, the Sect Master of the Heavenly Secrets Sect and a supreme cultivation expert, fails his heavenly tribulation during ascension—

Only to be reborn into the body of a fool. From that moment on, he embarks on an unstoppable path of domination. Anyone who dares stand in his way will be blown apart with a single punch! Whether it’s powerful sects or wealthy elite families, all of them are nothing more than ants before him!

215757.description:
The first comic anthology of the hugely popular TV anime "Grow Up Show"!

Holding hands, sometimes laughing, sometimes clashing, they chase their dreams—short stories of the "Sunflower Circus" members packed into one volume! Plus, that character makes an appearance...!? A must-see short story collection for "Grow Up Show" fans, focusing on the relationships between the characters!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

215758.description:
The assassin you imagine: sneaking in silence, lurking in the shadows, emerging from the corner to strike with lethal precision, and vanishing without a trace. But Yu Zhun’s code is different: declaring loudly like a chuunibyou (delusional teenager), "My name is Yu Zhun, and I'm here to kill you today!" One-hit kill! One-hit kill!! One-hit kill!!! The most useless SSS-rank assassin talent, yet in Yu Zhun's hands, it becomes the strongest!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

215760.description:
Pediatrician Kong Lan never imagined that when he would see his first love from ten years ago again, he would have become the Federation’s most dangerous commander Eugene. An unexpected incident involving a patient once again entwined their fates. Faced with a stalker closing in, out-of-control glands, and raging pheromones, the more they tried to escape, the more they were drawn to each other. This time, they were destined never to part again.

215770.description:
Mun Do-Hyeon, the manager of the popular idol group Byrex, rushes to a gay club after receiving instructions to "bring the member back before he causes trouble." There, intoxicated, Do-Hyeon impulsively has a one-night stand with Seo Jun-Hyeok, a man who feels unfamiliar yet somehow familiar. The next day, Do-Hyeon realizes that the man from the previous night is Seo Jun-Hyeok, a popular composer who is now a success in the industry and a junior from his high school club who had confessed his feelings to him in the past only to be rejected. What makes the situation even more awkward is that they are bound to run into each other frequently at work. Coincidentally, the group Do-Hyeon manages receives a song from Jun-Hyeok, and the two become entangled professionally. Concerned by Jun-Hyeok's changed attitude and gaze, Do-Hyeon begins to look into his personal circumstances and past emotions he was previously unaware of. For Do-Hyeon, who once dreamed of becoming a musician but was frustrated and has been living in compromise with reality, this reunion with Jun-Hyeok is not just a simple happening. It serves as an opportunity to confront forgotten and abandoned dreams and closed hearts again, and the relationship between the two begins to flow in a new direction.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: Sing it!

215771.description:
Hae-Il and Hyeon grew up like brothers in an orphanage. But one day, Hyeon began to be plagued by a strange desire to attack Hae-Il every night, and, strangely enough, he couldn’t recall any of it in the morning. To find the cause, Hae-Il seeks out Sa-Wol, a nine-tailed fox shaman who has lived for 300 years. The moment he sees Hae-Il, Sa-Wol instinctively senses that he is the “divine object” that will ease his curse...

“I’ll give you what you need, so you must give me what I want.”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

215772.description:
Tanizaki's novel tells the story of an ordinary salaryman named Joji Kawai, who meets a 15-year-old beautiful waitress at a cafe named Naomi. Joji makes an agreement with Naomi to live together "like friends," and gives her education and lessons of manners befitting a wife. However, Naomi turns into a woman Joji never expected.

(Source: Anime News Network)

215775.description:
The easiest way to absorb as much magic as possible is to touch lips.

One day, saintess powers awoke within Fatiah, an orphan. She was then adopted by a viscount who heard of her powers, but she lost her power almost immediately upon living there. Not only that, but Loretta, the daughter of the viscount, was instead able to use the saintess's power! Fatiah was now a former saintess and was kicked out of the viscount's house even though she had nowhere to go. That was when she was saved by the mysterious, handsome young man, Lionel. He's a former sorcerer who had to quit when he was cursed. Fatiah ended up living with him so she could learn how to use her magic. That's the beginning of the overly sweet life of the former saintess and the ex-sorcerer who have begun living together...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

215776.description:
Japan has been invaded by the secret society "Black Devil," which aims to overthrow the government. Top hero Minemizu Mineta spends his days as a "professional hero" protecting the peace of the city from the enemy. However, following a certain incident, "Black Devil" has introduced a complete two-day weekend system. Consequently, the heroes also have to follow the same work schedule. Minemizu, a workaholic, is thrown into chaos by the "two blank days," but there is another reason for his confusion──

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

いきもにあっく！

215778.description:
Je-I, a so-called “study freak” who always lives by his plans and routines. Je-I’s once-perfect daily life begins to waver little by little because of Ha I-Sol, the transfer student sitting next to him. A bet on grades between the two, sparked by the worst possible first impression. These two young people, who were complete opposites, gradually come to understand each other and begin to change each other’s worlds. A coming-of-age romance written together by a model student who only believed in the “right answers” and a free-spirited transfer student.

(Source: Naver, translated)

215779.description:
College freshman quarterback Wyatt Hess. Upon entering college, he became roommates with DeMarcus Winter, the prince of the football world. The strange thing is, there isn't a single woman around this seemingly perfect prince. And on top of that... he's a virgin?! Thus began the 'Operation DeMarcus Winter Loses His Virginity.'

...Huh? But why did he suddenly go to the bathroom while talking to me? And why is his face turning red?

215781.description:
Jang Chu-Gong works at a "black company” where once you're hired, you can never quit. Seeing two lines on his pregnancy test, he's convinced he has testicular cancer and happily heads home. And then there’s Dae Beom-Su who’s been held captive in his home for two years. Now that he’s finally managed to get sick leave, he’s thrilled at the thought of spending the whole day having his way with him…

“Sir, you don’t have testicular cancer, you’re pregnant.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: It's a Miracle, but Too Much

A star-studded creative team brings us the next chapter following Hirohiko Araki’s debut serial, Mashounen BT! Witness the enduring friendship between BT and Koichi, spanning eras from Mashounen BT to Maroushinshi BT, and prepare for thrilling new battles of wits and deception!

215784.description:
Today my cat-girl black cat is carefree as always!
"If I had a cat like that I'd do my best everyday!" "I'd also want to live with this cat!" The acclaimed social media hit "Kuroneko-chan" series get serialized with over 40 original pages!
A woman adopts sister black cats Kuro and Mame. Her wish, "I hope you both grow nice and big", has an unexpected result the next day when Kuro suddenly takes the shape of a human girl...!?
Playing with toys together, begging for affection during work hours, yet blissfully ignoring requests and then getting upset at... Days with these free spirited black cats are full of happiness!
This is a manga about the warm and kind daily experiences of two carefree black cats and the owner who just can't keep them under control! Contains over 40 original pages about things like taking baths or dealing cats that hating taking medication!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Can Banki defeat the assassins and serve customers safely?! A Demon Prince x Part-time Job x Battle Fantasy begins!!

Soohyun loses his place to live after falling victim to a rental deposit scam. Of all people, he ends up staying at his former homeroom teacher's house. The woman he once found intimidating has a secret(?) side to her...?

"You can keep this secret from the others, right...? In return, I'll help you relax ♥️ "

215793.description:
Asahi, a boy who likes stories with bad endings, meets Tsukino, a beautiful girl, at the movie theater. She loves bad endings just like he does, and the two hit it off immediately. Reluctantly, they eventually said goodbye and went their separate ways… only to find themselves both ending up at Asahi’s house, and Tsukino claims she lives here, too. It wasn't like that this morning, and Tsukino seemed completely unaware of Asahi's situation!? After investigating, Asahi was forced to conclude that Tsukino is actually the same person as himself in a parallel world — and she had somehow wandered into this world. Asahi agrees to help Tsukino return to her original world, but he can’t help but be drawn to a girl who’s exactly his type — and Tsukino seems feels the same way…

A romantic comedy woven between two people who are just a little too much alike!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

215794.description:
The Demon Lord, who was once defeated in battle by a hero, was suddenly transported from the demon world to modern-day Japan due to a runaway spell she cast at the end of the battle. Having efficiently recovered most of the magical power she had lost in the previous battle by consuming modern food, the Demon Lord returns to the Demon World once again. Despite reigning over the demon world as the Demon Lord, she frequently makes secret visits to Japan, spending her days eating easily obtainable convenience store food. One day, by chance, she came across a back alley in a busy downtown area and ended up helping a girl who was being harassed by several men. As a reward for helping her, she was taken to a cozy oden restaurant... The serious and rigid "Demon Lord" discovers truly delicious food and drinks, and friends to share them with after work.

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

215796.description:
Amamiya Nagisa was very much in love with the evil marquis Neun, a character from her favourite light novel. On the verge of her death, what awaited her on the other side wasn't oblivion, but being reincarnated into Neun's younger sister Frau! They might not be related by blood, but in the world of the novel, love between siblings is horribly taboo. Unable to bear the thought of anyone else having her beloved Neun, she will become the villainess Frau, tear down all his romance flags, and give them to him herself!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

An anthology comic from "Otherworld Heroine Fantasy" is here! Enjoy the stories of heroines who overcome troubles such as broken engagements, banishment from their families, and condemnation events to find happiness!

From the up-and-coming author of Hana Yondan to Issho comes a story depicting the struggles of a manga artist before and after World War II.

1933, the year Japan withdrew from the League of Nations and the Nazis seized power in Germany. Shin Hakubi, an unsuccessful manga artist, takes the biggest gamble of his life. His ambition to create a huge hit with a manga called Buchineko Yondou Suhei (Spotted Cat Fourth Class Seaman), a parody of Norakuro Joushouhei (Private Norakuro), matches the times when the sense of impending war was growing stronger, and leads Shin Hakubi to a position no one could have imagined...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

A hugely popular anthology of fantasy romance comics! Unexpected happiness awaits you♪

Reincarnated heroine, a noblewoman with a broken engagement, age-gap marriage, etc... This anthology contains 5 one-shot manga stories with happy endings, all themed around heroines facing their destinies and achieving dramatic reversals!

A compilation of the netorare family series "Omae no Kaa-chan Ikutoki no Kao Sugee Busu dazo w.
In addition to the four main stories, this volume includes bonus papers distributed at Comiket and short manga previously published on fan-support sites.

215801.description: Isabella, the daughter of a noble ducal family, glared at Gil, the son of a count, who spoke to her kindly at their first meeting with the intention of getting engaged and then delivered a powerful slap to him. In reality, Isabella had always harbored feelings for Gil, but her feelings for him had led her to act recklessly... Meanwhile, Gil hears some bad rumors about Isabella from his classmates... Then Gil comes across a scene where a female student screams, calling out Isabella's name, and what Gil sees there is... A romantic comedy about a young lady whose unrequited love has gone awry and a poor apprentice knight, a love story with a huge social class gap!!
synonyms: The Happy Dark History of a Complicated Lady: A Secret Approach to Being Doted on by an Oblivious Knight
The Lovestruck Lady's Secret Plan to Win Over the Oblivious Knight

The protagonist, Ikuto, was on friendly terms with Keiko, a single mother who lived in the same apartment building. One day, while Ikuto was going about his daily masturbation routine in his room, he must have forgotten to close the window—and Keiko, living on the floor below, heard him…! Frustrated by the demands of raising a child and working full-time, Keiko couldn’t take it anymore and went to Ikuto’s room… “If you’d like… maybe I could help you out…?” And so… his first-ever sexual experience began, carried along by the flow of events… Wow…! An older woman’s pussy… felt this good…!! Every move Keiko made—with her wealth of experience—was too intense… Ikuto found himself becoming more and more hooked on Keiko’s body, even though she was more than a decade older than him────

When the Cat Distribution System strikes, there's no denying your fate! And for one worn-out author, this blessing could be exactly what she needs—as long as she accepts her new position of servitude, that is! An adorable, full-color cat comic that will warm your heart.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

215804.description:
Drug cartels have turned the American continent into a breeding ground for crime. Among them, “Kinalroa” — the largest and most powerful organization — recruits children by any means necessary and raises them as assassins known as “Sicarios.” Lee Se-fa survives the brutal, hellish training to its very end, growing into an elite killer. However, he is ensnared in his boss’s trap and is forced to kill his closest comrades with his own hands — a tragedy he cannot undo. Feeling utterly betrayed, Se-fa tears the organization apart from within, then returns to South Korea — the homeland that abandoned him when he was just a child. But his fleeting taste of a peaceful life is short-lived. Domestic and international criminal forces hunting him down, the ghosts of his past who survived, and the relentless pursuit of law enforcement closing in on all sides — all of it drives him back onto the battlefield. Lee Se-fa, the Sicario, carries a blade of revenge in his heart.But who truly is the “real enemy” that blade must be pointed at…?

Cho Seong-U, the ace of the “First Generation” and the top star in college basketball, dreams of making it to the NBA. He possesses exceptional talent, more than anyone else, and is just as arrogant and self-righteous. Kang Seol-Hyeon has always looked up to him. Although he started playing basketball late and lacks both a dazzling career and overwhelming physical prowess, he works harder than anyone else and possesses an outstanding shooting touch. Seo-Gyeom, whose long-standing unrequited love ended with his ex vanishing without a trace, had been trying hard to forget the painful wound and living a relatively smooth life, but as they say, life is a series of hardships. His ex-boyfriend Jae-O, who suddenly reappears out of the blue, tries to manipulate Seo-Gyeom just like before.

Will he be able to break free from this cycle and achieve a clean break?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Suzune was just about to turn 30 when her boyfriend of three years dumped her, and admitted he had been cheating the whole time! Furious and depressed, she heads to Miyazaki Prefecture to cleanse her soul while filming videos for her travel-themed social channel. There she meets Yuujin, a mysterious young novelist struggling with writer's block. After a drunken night together, Yuujin realizes Suzune might be just the inspiration he needs, and asks her an unexpected question: “will you travel with me?”

(Source: Omoi)

The girl I encountered in town, my spitting image, turned out to be a runaway princess?! Through a bizarre turn of events, the village girl Freya is forced to live in the royal palace as a stand-in for the princess who fled. Exposure means certain death! Desperate to protect herself, Freya plays the role of the princess, only to witness the harsh reality of the princess's existence: a neglectful emperor father, an apathetic fiancé, and malicious maids. "To get the princess to return, I have to fix this environment!" Freya resolves, using her natural grit and optimism to defy the scorn of those who see her as an "incompetent princess"!

(Source: Sorajima, translated)

The purpose of the marriage was to be a sacrifice to seal Welflem's powers. For the sake of her hometown and to be of use as a saint, Renisha tried to fulfill her role as a bride, but Welflem refused to enter into a holy marriage

215857.description:
The crown princess Lune Renard has been captured by the revolutionary army, condemned to death as the vixen who threw the nation into chaos by hiding her past as a lowly orphan. However, Lune never wanted to be the crown princess, and her marquis adoptive father practically sold her to the crown prince. But as she and her family are executed, the Great Fox Spirit Reineke hears Lune’s prayers and sends her back in time to avert this terrible fate. What’s more, she now has fox ears that can hear the voices of spirits! Lune is determined to save her people, but she must first win over House Renard, the family that adopted her but always treated her coldly—especially her brother Liam. She was sure that Liam hated her, but now he’s always doting on her! With Liam and the spirits by her side, Lune will find a happy ending for everyone!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

215858.description:
For high school saxophonist Kodai, music was always his escape. Or it was, until a devastating anxiety attack onstage cost his band a competition. Now forced to confront his mother’s remarriage with no way out, he finds himself with a new family and a new stepbrother, the gloomy and withdrawn Fuyuki. Yet beneath that intimidating exterior lies a gentle, guitar-loving soul. As Fuyuki helps Kodai overcome his fear of performing, gratitude deepens into something far deeper—and far more complicated. But when it comes time for Kodai to help Fuyuki face the trauma that silenced his own music, will their bond strike a powerful new chord or will it collapse beneath the pressure?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

215859.description:
Former child actor turned struggling idol Eiri is on the verge of being fired from his agency when he’s handpicked by Shoui, a perfectionist photographer whose model is treated as nothing less—and nothing more—than his muse. As this generation’s muse, Eiri knows that Shoui will sleep with him if he asks, but that won’t melt the icy walls around the notoriously distant genius’s heart. Determined not to fall too deeply in love, Eiri suppresses his feelings for over a decade...until the day a new muse appears. Now Eiri must choose which fear he’s willing to face: potentially being rejected, or losing his only shot before he even has a chance.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Twenty-year-old Ebato Aoi has hit rock bottom. Out of school since his early teens, unable to keep a job or a girlfriend, and scraping by on crash-for-cash scams, he’s headed nowhere fast. Then he picks the wrong mark: the absurdly handsome CEO riding in an absurdly expensive car, Inami Takane. Given the choice between jail time and becoming Inami’s fake boyfriend, Aoi takes the obvious option. But he soon realizes that serving time might have been easier to handle than playing boyfriend to a prickly, arrogant CEO...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

215861.description:
A love story that crosses nations and status between the otaku prince and the game developer who stole his heart.

Charmed by the poignant simplicity of an indie game called Hanabi, Alphonse Eklund, fifth prince of Edihara, knows he has to meet the Japanese developer behind his favorite game. It has no quests or battles, only a small sparkler that burns down to nothing. Against his father’s better judgment, he moves to Japan to do exactly that. But Akito, the game’s sole creator, turns out to be an anxious university student who has no faith in his work. Bewildered at first, Alphonse soon becomes determined to make Akito see his creations’ true worth. Concealing his royal identity, Alphonse starts visiting the café where Akito works, closing the distance between them little by little. The closer they grow, the harder it is to keep his heart—and his hands—to himself.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Every ten months and ten days, Shinto priest Yoichi is forced to butcher a monstrous creature and serve the flesh to the villagers. He's unsatisfied with this life, stuck in a closed-off village, but hesitates to leave and explore the outside world. When his childhood friend, Kyo, returns to the village after Yoichi's father dies, he tries to convince Yoichi to leave and run away with him. But there's a darker secret keeping Yoichi there—one that will change everything between the two of them.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A girl who can't use magic. A partner who never wanted her. And a killer who's already chosen their target.

Emma has dreamed of attending the prestigious Royal Academy of Magic her entire life. There's just one problem. She can't use magic.

On the day of the entrance ceremony, Emma's dreams seem destined to shatter... until a chance encounter with the aloof and sharp-tongued Phyllis changes everything. After the two unexpectedly take the entrance exam together, they're assigned as a provisional pair, much to their mutual dismay.
