215880.description:
“Wouldn't being a wealthy commoner be the best option?”

After being reincarnated from a hard-charging career in the trading business, Sara finds herself plotting her future from within the marquis's household that has taken her in. If she remains an unwelcome guest, the best she can hope for is becoming some nobleman's second wife, forever looked down upon for her commoner origins. Her solution? Take full advantage of the backing of her wealthy new family while making a strategic retreat to their remote territory, where she can quietly build up enough capital to strike out on her own. At least, that was the plan…

When Sara arrives, she discovers that embezzlement has pushed the territory to the brink of financial ruin! With her all-important patron in trouble, there's no point in playing the sweet, innocent little girl anymore. Using long-forgotten alchemical research buried in the castle as leverage, Sara begins headhunting talented personnel. She pressures the guild into developing the local mines to secure a new source of income, all while throwing the adults around her completely off balance as she works to rebuild the territory's economy. And before long, at only eight years old, Sara is already setting out on the path to building a mercantile empire powerful enough to have even a marquis at her beck and call!

Family, adults, nobles—it doesn't matter who stands in her way. Armed with a sharp business mind and an eye for profit, this merchant heiress is ready to make a fortune!

(Source: Hanashi Media)

title.english: The Merchant Heiress is Unstoppable with the Power of Money
title.native: 商人令嬢はお金の力で無双する
title.romaji: Shounin Reijou wa Okane no Chikara de Musou Desu

215881.description:
After a long and grueling war against the Kingdom of Arcadia, the Galleria Empire stands on the brink of collapse. On the hellish front lines of its most brutal battlefield, a young girl's scream rings out: “This isn't what you promised! This isn't what you promised! This isn't what you promised at all!” The voice belongs to Lina, an eight-year-old girl who enlisted in the military to save the orphanage that raised her. She can't wield a sword or use magic. All she has is the unassuming skill Multilingual Comprehension—and memories of a past life spent enduring endless overtime at an exploitative company and playing strategy simulation games! Lina was promised a well-paid desk job at a safe command post. Instead, she finds herself in the middle of the battlefield, forced into the role of a mysterious military strategist. No one yet realizes that the commands issued by her tiny hands will overturn every convention and completely transform the course of the war—not even Lina herself. As for Lina, she has only one desperate request: a slice of deliciously sweet cake.

(Source: Hanashi Media)
synonyms: ようこそ最前線の地獄（職場）へ 軍師リナ、8歳です

title.english: Welcome to Your New Workplace: The Hellish Front Lines! Lina, Strategist, Age Eight
title.native: ようこそ最前線の地獄

215882.description:
Can a tomato field really become the foundation of a nation?! An exiled priest builds a kingdom from the ground up!

Cello, a priest of light, shields the Hero from the Sixth Demon Lord's curse—only to be transformed into a demon himself. As his reward, he is cast out of the Hero's party and forcibly teleported far away. At his destination, Cello encounters Lucy, the Sixth Demon Lord's daughter, who recognizes in him the potential to become a Demon Lord. Together with the demons now serving under him, Cello sets out to develop his new territory. Then, one day, the Hero's party arrives to eliminate him. But when they venture into the tomato field outside Cello's castle, they discover monsters lurking among the crops—each one enhanced by Cello's abilities!

What was supposed to be a simple field of tomatoes may prove to be the most unconquerable dungeon of all!

(Source: Hanashi Media, edited)

title.english: Living the Slow Life as a Demon Lord: The Hero Says My Tomato Field Is an Unconquerable Dungeon!
title.native: 魔王スローライフを満喫する～勇者から「攻略無理」と言われたけど、そこはダンジョンじゃない。トマト畑だ～
title.romaji: Maou Slow Life wo Mankitsu Suru: Yusha kara "Kouryaku Mura" to Iwareta kedo, Soko wa Dungeon Janai. Tomato Hatake da

215883.description:
Everyone experiences their own unique love at some point! It doesn't matter if the partner is of the opposite sex or the same sex, even if they're not human or have a significant age difference! Because the love you share with "you" is the most important thing. A gem of an original "love" short story anthology drawn by talented manga artists from ASUKA!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Falling in Love with You: The Moment You Became My Everything

title.native: オリジナルコミックアンソロジー あなたと、恋。~君が一番になった瞬間~
title.romaji: Original Comic Anthology: Anata to, Koi. Kimi ga Ichiban ni natta Shunkan

title.native: 当て馬大好きセシリアちゃん ～ヒロインの姉に転生したので、負けヒーローの推しを救います～
title.romaji: Ateuma Daisuki Cecilia-chan: Heroine no Ane ni Tensei Shita node, Make Hero no Oshi wo Sukuimasu

title.native: 死にたがりの王女

215886.description:
Baker Margot and her ghostly assistant Miro make specialty cakes for the dearly departed. Each cake is made custom—tailored to the lost individual. Still-living loved ones share their memories of the deceased which serve as inspiration for the flavors and style, creating a truly one-of-a-kind cake. First, a mystery novelist spends her time volunteering at a hospital to read to patients and meets a blind young woman who grew up in the hospital. The two bond over mystery novels, inspiring the Mystery Novel Crepe cake, a cake made with crepe layers like the pages of a book. Then, the daughter of a vampire reminisces over her daytime life and the hours that separated her from her night-bound mother, and the moments they shared in an evening primrose field inspiring the Evening Primrose Cupcake. The love and care put into each cake will surely bring comfort to both living and dead in this heartwarming story of love and loss.

(Source: Dark Horse)

Note:
- Includes four extra chapters.
- Won the KOCCA President's Award at the Korea Content Awards in 2022
- Won Best U.S. Edition of International Material - Asia at the Eisner Awards in 2026.

title.native: 장례식 케이크 전문점 연옥당

215887.description:
High school student Reo drifts through life, keeping his head down. He has a part time job, a girlfriend, a sense of anxiety he can't shake, and a recurring dream about the taste of another boy's lips... And when the long-lost friend he kissed suddenly resurfaces, that childhood memory might change all three of their lives forever.

(Source: K MANGA)

title.native: Still You

215888.description:
Cha Seo-Jin is a college student leading a weary life plagued by sleep paralysis due to her ability to see ghosts. One day, while being kidnapped and harassed by a ghost, Seo-Jin is rescued by Seung-Do, an exorcist, by chance. Falling for Seung-Do, who protected her so admirably, he begins a relationship with him. Their romance starts with a heart-fluttering excitement. However, as his feelings for Seung-Do deepen, he begins to see increasingly suspicious behavior from him...

"After all, Seo-Jin, you were born with quite a mouthwatering soul."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 귀신도 꿈을 꿀까요?

215889.description: Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: Doing Bad Things Behind My Husband's Back

title.native: 남편 몰래 나쁜 짓

215890.description:
On the Red Planet, hundreds of millions of kilometers from Earth, a secret, cutting-edge technology is captured by a group of Earthlings, who were thought to have been wiped out over 300 years ago. A security force tasked with the mission of protecting interstellar order is deployed in response, and trail behind the Earthling pirates in hot pursuit. This crossing of paths shall uncover the fate of a race seeking to wield technology to advance beyond the stars. But will the tale it tells be one of caution, or one of hope?

(Source: K MANGA)

title.native: THE LAST TERRAN

215892.description:
In the affordable apartment, the flower girl next door has an atmosphere that's 100% elf. But she's a bit laid-back, so, I'll still call myself 'Non-Elf' for now.
It's…. Just a slightly different world from my 2DK, right next door fantasy comedy.

title.native: エルフっぽい花さんのてきと～なアパートぐらし
title.romaji: Elf-ppoi Hana-san no Tekitou na Apartment-gurashi

215893.description:
Shingo Takahashi, who had an ordinary but happy family with his wife and daughter, suddenly finds himself burdened with a 40 million yen debt because he co-signed a loan for a friend who disappeared... He's even told he might have to use his wife and daughter's bodies to repay it. Cornered, Shingo is offered a job in the underworld if he can't come up with the money to repay the debt!? A suspenseful thriller about a ruthless job in the underworld!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

title.native: マイルド

215894.description:
"I love you. Only you from the bottom of my heart..." The earnest courtship of a childhood friend who reunited for the first time in 18 years won't stop!?

Aoi Hayakawa (31), who works at an advertising agency, is just an ordinary office worker. Although she experienced the valley of her life a while ago, she was living a normal life, One day, her childhood friend Ren appears in front of her for the first time in several years. In addition, she was handed her marriage registration with her parent's signature, and a sudden "proposal"!? To Aoi who is confused, Ren tells her overflowing feelings...

"I want to taste Aa-chan's whole body." Her body reacts when she is stared at by her lustful eyes and entwined with her hot tongue... I can't resist this anymore!!

(Source: Clap Comix, translated)

title.native: 求愛婚 〜18年振りに再会した御曹司に毎晩イキすぎる程愛されています〜
title.romaji: Kyuuai Kon: 18-nenburi ni Saikai Shitai Onzoushi ni Maiban Ikisugiru Hodo Aisareteimasu

215895.description:
The Sugary Chapter of Kirito and Asuna’s Honeymoon in SAO Finally Published!

Around the time the 75th Floor of《Aincrad》started being cleared, Kirito and Asuna confirmed their mutual feelings and finally married.

"...Yes, you can do as you wish... Because I'm only yours, Kirito-kun."

The sugary chapter of Kirito and Asuna's honeymoon in SAO is finally available to the public!

But wait, there's more.

"Hey... what if we order a handmade rocking chair?"

To fulfill the young wife request, Kirito and Asuna visit the master wood artisan player Mahokl, without knowing that it would involve them into a very unexpected situation...

Note: It was originally written and released in parts as short stories by the author at COMITIA doujinshi conventions, with each edition containing around 20 pages.

title.native: ソードアート・オンライン　マテリアル シュガーリィ・デイズ
title.romaji: Sword Art Online Material: Sugary Days

215896.description:
Young Will was an orphan with no one to rely on. He was dying in a corner of the slums when he was saved by a mercenary who happened to pass by. Will wanted to join the mercenary group in order to survive. He was given an impossible entrance test—but his talent was recognized, and he was provisionally accepted into the kingdom's strongest mercenary group!? Under the guidance of the group's members, who are among the world's greatest fighters, Will's extraordinary potential blossoms, and before he knew it, he was respected by the members as well—!? The ultimate growth fantasy of an extraordinary disciple raised by invincible masters!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 傭兵団の愛し子 ～死にかけ孤児は最強師匠たちに育てられる～
title.romaji: Yoheidan no Itoshigo: Shinikake Koji wa Saikyou Shisho-tachi ni Sodaterareru

title.native: 天才少女の暇つぶし
のあンちのガチ家族会議
title.romaji: Noan Chi no Gachi Kazoku Kaigi

215899.description:
Mizushima, an elementary school boy clever beyond his years, has been getting by in school with ease, but is constantly searching for some spark of excitement in his rather monotonous daily life. Then one day, he witnesses his classmate Taguchi stealing offerings from a shrine…

The reminiscence of an unforgettable secret and the ache of lingering emotions.

(Source: K MANGA)

title.native: さいせんどろぼう
異世界☆シュガーマジック〜魔王城でスイーツ革命〜
title.romaji: Isekai☆Sugar Magic: Maoujou de Sweets Kakumei

215901.description:
The moment Lee Hyeon launches the legendary horror game Unreal, he finds himself trapped inside it. Waking up in a school in the dead of night, he meets Da-Yeon, a mysterious high school girl. There is only one way to survive here: solve the chilling puzzles and uncover the hidden rules. Will the two of them be able to end this game of death and return to reality?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Surviving in an RPG Maker Horror Game

title.native: 공포 쯔꾸르 생존기

215902.description:
A complete comic adaptation of the 1997 blockbuster “Crayon Shin-chan: The Great Tam-Tam Chase.” What will become of the Nohara family as they get caught up in a battle over a haniwa that holds the magical power of the legendary demon Jark, and the two “Tam-Tams” that hold the key to breaking the seal? A blockbuster packed with laughter and suspense.

(Source: Futabasha)

title.native: 映画クレヨンしんちゃん 暗黒タマタマ大追跡

215903.description:
1. Mazushiki Fruit (貧しきフリュート)
2. Tobidashite Oide BANANA BABY (飛び出しておいでBANANA BABY)
3. Beach Sandal (ビーチサンダル)

15. Yoru ni Tsuki Tatsu Hari (夜に突き立つ針)

title.native: ピッピュ
봇물 터지는 썰

215905.description: As a pirate ship captain, Jamuka was living the good life, surrounded by plenty of treasure, food and alcohol. However, one fateful day, his ship attacked the transport of the beautiful Princess Kana. Kana was on a journey to seek help for her homeland, the small island country of Wa, which was under attack. Her plan was stopped short when Jamuka sunk her ship and took both Kana and her bodyguard Kagura as prisoners. But Princess Kana won't give up that easily! If Jamuka's band of pirates is the only force she has access to, she's going to do whatever it takes to convince them to save her home! Luckily, Jamuka requires very little persuading when it comes to beautiful women offering him whatever he wants. But will he be able to convince his crew to follow him into such danger? Jamuka's big adventure is about to begin!

title.native: 怒濤! ジャムカの大冒険

synonyms: I Was Picked as the Tyrant's Daughter-in-Law

title.native: 폭군의 며느리로 점찍혔습니다

215907.description:
Curious about your favorite author's absolute favorite work? This time, the authors have become readers themselves to offer genuine recommendations. From "Commentaries" with maxed-out fangirling skills and "Worldview Mixes" featuring favorite characters to "Spin-off Fanfics" exploding with devotion—the recommendation styles, reactions, and levels of fandom are all unique. Follow the authors' sincere affection and discover a new masterpiece!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: [특집] 최애 작가의 최애 만화가 궁금해!

synonyms: Wasn't I the Female Lead of a Regret Novel?
Wasn't I the Heroine of a Regret Novel?

title.native: 저 후회물 여주 아니었나요?

215909.description:
I was South Korea’s top idol survival show producer—until I opened my eyes and found myself reincarnated as Edith, the only daughter of the new emperor who had overthrown a tyrant through revolution. Using the knowledge from my previous life and alchemy, I somehow managed to help bring the tyrant down. But what awaited us afterward was an imperial family whose reputation among the people had already hit rock bottom. So, to resuscitate the dying imperial family, I decided to pull out my secret weapon: a survival competition where the people themselves vote to select the Empire’s finest order of knights! Drawing on the skills from my past life, I rolled up my sleeves, ready to manufacture drama with some ruthless evil editing.

But… what is this? Who are these contestants with such perfectly compelling stories that they don’t even need evil editing? Unmatched visuals that require no editing, emotional backstories impossible to watch without tears, and on top of that, intense bromance chemistry that constantly blurs the line between friendship and love! Maybe this… could become an even bigger hit than the masterpiece I created in my previous life!

A fierce survival competition featuring knights determined to capture your heart.

title.native: 당신의 기사에게 투표하세요!
隣ノ雌妻
淫乱発掘～ビッチ育成計画～
メンヘラ○○させてみた

215913.description:
1-2. Otome no Mitame ga Kawaisugite Tamaranai (乙女の見た目が可愛すぎてたまらない); Comic Megastore α 2015-02, 03
3. Otome no Junan wa Mada Tsuzuku (乙女の受難はまだつづく); Comic Megastore α 2015-09
4. Midara na... (みだらな…); Comic Megastore α 2015-01

6-7. Ring♡In (RING♡淫); Comic Megastore α 2014-08, 10
8. Shimai Maimai (しまいマイマイ); Comic Megastore α 2015-04

乙女の見た目が可愛すぎてたまらない
Otome no Junan wa Mada Tsuzuku
乙女の受難はまだつづく
Kyou Baito Owari ni Sex Shimasu.
きょうバイト終わりにセックスします。

title.native: Harem淫Battle♥

215914.description:
Abandoned by the Heavenly Demon, the ruler of all demons, Dokgo Yeon-Mi takes in Dokgo Cheon, a baby resembling the heavens themselves. As they attempt to live the life of the Dokgo clan, unconnected to either the Heavenly Demon or the Divine Cult, the Heavenly Demon reappears before them. Due to a twist of fate, Dokgo Yeon-Mi is destined to become a priestess, and to protect her, Dokgo Cheon devotes himself to the Divine Cult...

'If the Heavenly Demon stands in my way, I will become the Heavenly Demon!'

Dokgo Cheon's sword begins to cleave the world against the Heavenly Demon who shattered his peace!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Heavenly Father Has Turned the World Upside Down
The Heavenly Demon Will Turn the World Upside Down
暴れん坊天魔様、天下を覆す

title.native: 천마님 천하를 뒤집어 놓으셨다

215915.description: Hwa-Jeong is pregnant and dreams of a happy married life. However, her hopes are shattered by her fiancé's betrayal. Just when she thinks she has lost everything, someone approaches her with unexpected news: having grown up as an orphan with no family, she has inherited 50 billion won. Will Hwa-Jeong be able to accept the inheritance and find happiness?

title.native: 위대한 유산

215916.description:
"I'm going to relive my first love with the older sister I've always admired."

Kazari, an engineer at a VTuber production company, has an otaku-like personality and can talk endlessly about the things he likes, but at work he gets stuck for words and can't say a word, which has left him feeling troubled.

At that time, he remembers Koto, a kind older girl from his neighborhood who used to practice speaking with him when he was in elementary school.

Koto had died of an illness, and he thought he would never see her again... But in the spring 10 years after their eternal farewell, they have an unexpected reunion...!? A streaming romantic comedy that begins with a reunion with the older sister he admired as a child!

title.native: はじめまして #初恋配信中

215917.description:
A slightly unusual coming-of-age story about a cross-dressing boy and a cross-dressing girl!

It's the first day of the new student council's activities! The newly appointed student council president (male) and vice president (female) each have serious problems. What can they do to alleviate the inescapable "fear" of each other...? A slightly unusual coming-of-age story about a cross-dressing boy and a cross-dressing girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Men Who Dress as Women and Women Who Dress as Men

title.native: 女装男と男装女

215918.description:
I'm the one on the offensive ♡ A thrilling "heroine on the offensive" comic anthology!!! The love for the gap is unstoppable...!? We bring you 6 brand new manga stories and illustrations by a super luxurious lineup of artists ♪

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: クールなアイツはわたしの前でだけカワイイ!? ヒロイン攻めコミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Cool na Aitsu wa Watashi no Mae de Dake Kawaii!?: Heroine Seme Comic Anthology

215919.description:
In the 20th year of the Keicho era, Hideyori committed suicide during the Summer Siege of Osaka, leading to the downfall of the Toyotomi family. Hideyori's wife and Ieyasu's granddaughter, Senhime, was rescued by the Tokugawa army. However, among the five ladies-in-waiting accompanying Senhime on her journey to Edo was a female ninja pregnant with Hideyori's child. Upon learning of this, Ieyasu secretly instructed Hattori Hanzo to dispose of Hideyori's child and summoned five ninjas from the Iga Tsubakakure village. A fierce battle ensues between the Sanada ninja corps of the Toyotomi side and the Iga Tsubakakure female ninja corps of the Tokugawa side!

(Source: Leed Publishing, translated)

title.native: くノ一忍法帖
옐로우 제트
김기범 : 어둠 아래 등불
원수를 사랑하라

synonyms: My Fave Is My Personal Manager

title.native: #推しが俺様専属マネージャー

synonyms: The Saintess Who Must Do It to Survive

title.native: 하지 않으면 죽는 성녀

synonyms: 아마츠카 군은 천사 같은 건 그만두고 싶어!

title.native: 天塚くんは天使なんかやめたいっ！

215927.description:
One review from the legendary Pi Do-Yeong can make or break a career. For So-Yeong, it did both. After saving her failing restaurant with a rave review, Do-Yeong’s strange behavior—visiting daily but refusing to eat—starts to ruin Verde’s credibility all over again. When So-Yeong corners him to settle the score, she finds a man driven mad by a thirst no wine can quench. Do-Yeong is a vampire losing control, and he’s just placed a very specific order. To save her life’s work, she enters a risky contract with the supernatural, but in this kitchen, the chef might just end up as the main course.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 주문하신 뱀파이어 나왔습니다
黒革と悪人

215929.description:
China, 400 years before the era of "Kingdom." The ruler of the great state of Qi is assassinated. Two princes vie for the throne, but only one can survive. Guan Zhong and Bao Shu, once close friends, find themselves on opposing sides of the struggle...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 管仲と鮑叔

215930.description:
I'm Tasogare Mirai! I'm a girl who's not very good at socializing! A foul-mouthed AI from the future has threatened me, saying, "If you keep going like this, you'll die alone!" But how do I make friends...? A near-future coming-of-age story brought to you by Kaiho Norimitsu and Kurageso!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title.native: 明るいミライ

215931.description: Judith, a minor character in a certain story, is a marquis's daughter despised by her family and fiancé, who has resigned herself to her miserable fate. "—What a boring life," thought the protagonist who was reading the story... until she suddenly found herself reborn as Judith! Having learned of the relentless pressure Judith endured and her desperate struggle to survive, the protagonist vows, "I'll make them all pay on her behalf!" She decides to put "a certain plan" into action to break free from the shackles binding Judith... A dramatic reversal from a life of oppression! A thrilling "serves you right" fantasy begins here!
synonyms: The Reborn Crybaby Heiress Is Full of Surprises
The Reborn Timid Heiress Is Full of Surprises

title.native: 今まで馬鹿にされていた気弱令嬢に転生したら、とんでもない事になった話、聞く？
title.romaji: Ima made Baka ni Sarete Ita Kiyowa Reijou ni Tensei Shitara, Tondemonai Koto ni Natta Hanashi, Kiku?

215932.description:
In a society of superhumans where “strength” is the sole standard, whether it be law or rule, So Yeo-Ul has lived his life as an underdog. For So Yeo-Ul, whose entire life had been about running away, losing his father at the hands of the strong spurs him to seek revenge, and he heads for the Combat Tower.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 심판

215933.description:
“Can't you let go of your first love? ...That was back in elementary school.”

Seo U-Jin, an “engineering nerd” who transformed from an unattractive kid into a heartthrob, has been pining for his first love for 10 years! Then one day, as if by magic, his first love appears right before his eyes…! She appears before the nerd who’s been in love with her for 10 years.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 역변! 첫사랑

215934.description:
A collection of poems written by an anarchist in prewar Japan. After being banned, imprisoned, and tortured, the words were burned to ashes. Following Japan’s defeat in the war, he changed his ways and became a capitalist—.

You can hear the poems of the voiceless—those who vanished at the juncture between the prewar and postwar eras.

In the basement of the Kurayami Kaikan (here), everything remains submerged to this day.

Saki, a librarian pursuing the mystery of the supernatural. Shun, a records clerk searching for buried treasure. Seira, a bartender who wants to change herself. Though the three set out for different reasons, they are eventually drawn together by a single poetry collection…

(Source: Torch Comics, translated)

title.native: ああ資本主義の悪の華はいつまで咲き誇るのか。
title.romaji: Aa Shihonshugi no Aku no Hana wa Itsu Made Sakihokoru no ka.

title.native: 彼岸の螢

215936.description:
The series follows a little girl who is left behind after an earthquake and a nuclear power plant accident with her cat. The two wait at home for the return of their family as they continue to housesit.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: るすばん猫きなこ

215937.description:
This is an essay manga by Tsunomaru, a popular manga artist known for works such as "Monmonmon" and the "Makibao" series. Tsunomaru currently lives with three rescue French bulldogs. After a long serialization that left him physically and mentally exhausted, he chose a life of "taking a break from manga and doting on dogs."

(Source: Fusosha, translated)

title.native: The Dogfather ドッグファーザー

215938.description:
Alright, it's time for class! Unleash your fists and shake up this school that has become a microcosm of modern Japan!! Manga artist Koichi Noguchi visits a high school to give a lecture. His words deeply move the students in the audience. Matsuyama, in particular, is struck by his words, drops out of high school, travels the world, and ultimately chooses to become a teacher. His new assignment is at a rough high school where every student is a delinquent. The unconventional new teacher, Matsuyama, takes on the school with nothing but his own strength!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ぶんなぐり先生

215939.description:
In a small suburban town, in one household, in one room, a man was found dead inside a box. To trace back to what caused such an event would take us some decades back... "My dad lives inside a box," said a sweet little five-year-old girl named Yumiko as she draws out a picture of a man's arm coming out of a box. Yumiko and her mother live alongside this man in the box. However, as Yumiko begins to grow up, the seeds of suspicion begin to bear fruit. "Who is actually inside that box?"

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 箱の男

215940.description:
Amamiya Riku, the class president at an all-boys boarding school, is interested in love and sex, but he spends his days seriously convinced they are out of his reach. Then one day, he is assigned the task of caretaker for the handsome and rumored troublemaker, Shidaka Satsuki. Always breaking curfew, Always fooling around with girls... Is this one of those playboys I hear about!? Just moments after they become roommates, "You're just so green, it makes me want to show you the ropes..." A whisper from a sweet voice while being gazed at with those beautiful eyes, plunge Riku's previously straightforward and serious mind and body into a pool of confusion. Large hands caress every curve of his body and his brain is almost fried with pleasure...!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: Playboy and His Lovenest Romance. All He Wants Is a Reward from The Class President.
title.native: プレイボーイと愛部屋ロマンス〜委員長のご褒美だけ欲しい
title.romaji: Playboy to Ai Heya Romance: Iinchou no Gohoubi dake Hoshii

synonyms: Trapped in a Dungeon with Monsters

title.english: Trapped in a Dungeon With Monsters
title.native: 마물들과 던전에 갇혔다

215942.description:
"Wanna try disciplining me again?"
Two stepbrothers, one long-suffering and one unruly, begin an unconventional life together under the same roof.

Asahi works from home and lives with Riku, his stepbrother seven years his junior. After finally reaching his breaking point with Riku's relentless selfish behavior, Asahi is caught off guard when Riku suggests that he "discipline him again." Though skeptical, Asahi agrees, and from that day on, Riku becomes surprisingly obedient. Then one night, Asahi is suddenly called to a bar, where he discovers a side of Riku he has never seen before: surrounded by unfamiliar men, completely unguarded, and radiating a dangerously seductive charm…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Raising My Stepbrother Sure Isn't Easy
title.native: 義弟を飼うのは難しい
title.romaji: Gitei wo Kau no wa Muzukashii

215943.description:
"Listen, Mr. Yukimine. Why don't you let me color you mine?"
A straitlaced teacher finds himself trapped in the obsessive affection of one of the most feared men in the yakuza.

Mr. Yukimine, a middle school teacher, works tirelessly every day, even sacrificing sleep, to ensure he never disappoints his students or their parents. Naturally, he thought he was fully prepared for the round of visits to his students' homes that had begun a few days earlier. But then he discovers that one of his students comes from a yakuza family! To make matters worse, Kuga, the right-hand man of the family's future boss, is there waiting for him and suddenly declares, "Mr. Yukimine, I like you." Terrified that refusing him might get him killed, Mr. Yukimine has no idea what to do. Yet despite Kuga's forceful advances, his touch is unexpectedly gentle. Even though he knows full well that he's in his student's home, Mr. Yukimine gradually finds himself unable to hold back the increasingly heated sounds escaping his lips...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Let Me Color You Mine, Mr. Yukimine!
title.native: 先生、俺に色づいて
地味巨乳はメスオナホ

215945.description:
Since being laid off, Satoshi Osako has been living in the countryside. His only pleasure is playing the VRRPG "Sword and Sorceress," where he enjoys carefree adventures as the great sage "Zelos Merlin." This is a prequel to "The Middle-Aged Sage's Otherworldly Life Diary," a pioneering work in the genre of stories about middle-aged men being reincarnated. Enjoy the outrageous gaming lives of the eccentric players!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title.native: アラフォー賢者の異世界生活日記 ZERO -ソード・アンド・ソーサリス・ワールド-
title.romaji: Arafou Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki ZERO: Sword and Sorcerers World

215946.description:
It has been 20 years since I became a hero of the kingdom in another world. I have obtained everything—honor, power... except for cola.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I’m Quitting Everything and Selling Cola

title.native: 다 때려치고 콜라 팝니다

215947.description:
All-new illustrations! An anthology comic of "doting love" in another world, brought to you by a popular collaboration between a novelist and a shojo manga artist!!

I was told I was a burden, but somehow I became the personal attendant of a genius mage...!? I was just a figurehead wife, engrossed in my hobbies!? Why am I still sleeping in a separate room from my husband 10 years after our arranged marriage...? What happened to me, who was dumped for being too handsome...!?

Enjoy four exquisite stories of doting love!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: I'm confused by this unexpected affection

title.native: 予想外の溺愛に、戸惑っています: ~ありのままの私でいいんですか?~アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Yosougai no Dekiai ni, Tomadotte imasu: Ari no Mama no Watashi de Iin desu ka? Anthology Comic

title.native: アラフォー賢者の異世界生活日記 ZERO -ソード・アンド・ソーサリス・ワールド-
title.romaji: Arafou Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki ZERO: Sword and Sorcerers World

215949.description:
College student Kotoha falls in love at first sight with Shima-kun, who saves her from being taken home by a guy after a drinking party. In order to win over the indifferent Shima-kun, Kotoha helps him investigate "truly disturbing stories" that he is obsessed with, but it seems that Kotoha has a constitution that attracts spirits and supernatural beings, and she is constantly in danger of losing her life—!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 眼下は昏い京王線です

215950.description:
A 10th-anniversary special side-story one-shot set after the end of The Promised Neverland.

Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2026 issue 39

title.english: The Promised Neverland: Special Bonus Chapter - Undying Blade
title.native: 約束のネバーランド 特別番外編 消えない刃
title.romaji: Yakusoku no Neverland: Tokubetsu Bangai-hen - Kienai Yaiba

215951.description:
You can win millions if you and your family survive 100 days in a haunted house? In order to win Disco at Night's grand prize, two families decide to come together and pretend to be one big family to win! The hilariously frightening story will now start.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 我们全家都戏精

215952.description:
Torii, a genius salesman who consistently ranks at the top of his class in every company he works for, encounters a hitman one day during a client visit. Just as he is about to be killed to silence him, Torii begins to speak— A natural-born devil ravages the underworld of demons and monsters! A rollercoaster mystery that will overturn your expectations begins now!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 殺し屋の営業術

215953.description:
A man named "Ittsu" steals a large sum of money from the yakuza and goes on the run! He might seem like a frivolous guy at first glance, but he ruthlessly fights back against anyone who tries to get their money back! Why would someone abandon their peaceful days to steal such a large sum of money from a single letter...

(Source: Hero's Inc, translated)

title.native: ヤマナミ

215954.description:
Betrayed by her husband and forced to watch her family perish, So-Hwa Tang, the brilliant Master of Poisons, exacts ruthless revenge before taking her own life. But death isn't the end. Awakening as her 17-year-old self, she makes a fierce vow: protect the Sichuan Tang clan at any cost. She doesn’t care about righteous justice or martial world politics. Her only goal is her family's survival. Yet as she brutally eliminates future threats, the world misinterprets her ruthless pragmatism as noble acts of chivalry. Follow So-Hwa as she accidentally becomes the martial world’s greatest heroine while simply trying to keep her family alive.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Eldest Daughter of the Tang Clan of Sacheon Protects the Family
The Eldest Daughter of the Sichuan Tang Clan Protects Her Family
La Fille Aînée du Clan Dang protège sa Famille
บุตรสาวคนโตผู้ปกป้องตระกูลทัง

title.english: The Eldest Daughter Protects the Tang Clan
title.native: 사천당가의 장녀는 가문을 지킨다

215955.description:
"I'll become a magnificent villainess worthy of being under the command of the demons!" Amelia, whose holy power was stolen by her stepsister and who was driven out of her home, finds herself in despair when she encounters Regulus, the Demon King who rules the forest. Cursed by Regulus, Amelia joins the ranks of the demons and decides to live as a villainess. However, she has absolutely no talent for being a villainess! Every "evil deed" she commits turns out to be a "good deed." At the Imperial Academy, which she enrolled in under the guise of training, she ends up being called the "Great Saint"!? She wants to become a magnificent villainess, but how did things end up like this? A chaotic school fantasy full of misunderstandings!

(Source: Jump Toon, translated)

title.native: 悪女にしてって言ったじゃん！涙
title.romaji: Akujo ni Shitette Itta Jan! Namida

title.native: 柔道部部長織原真琴が女になるまで
title.romaji: Juudoubu Buchou Orihara Makoto ga Onna ni Naru made

215957.description:
Two brothers with no official identity scrape by from day to day. But the elder brother dreams of rising through the ranks by passing the imperial exams. When he volunteers to take the exams in place of a powerful man’s son, he sets foot on a path that will change his fate... With nothing but a brush, overturn an age of power. 17th-century Ming China. The curtain rises on a tale of ambition, revenge, and the imperial examinations!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 科科科科

215958.description:
“Here, fantasy becomes reality! If you survive, that is.”

The protagonist arrives at a bizarre amusement park while searching for his missing daughter. A monster wearing a puppet mask appears before him and tells him that if he wants to find his daughter, he must play the games at the amusement park and survive. A death game thriller in which the protagonist must survive the deadly games set up at the amusement park to find his missing daughter.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 원더랜드

215959.description:
As a third-year developer, Lee Dan-Bi’s life motto was simple. Don’t covet the world beyond your own little pond; be content with reality. That’s why she was able to give up on a one-sided crush that was beyond her reach…

Today’s Horoscope - The start of the week: Watch out for a sudden tidal wave!

One morning that began with an unsettling horoscope, the newly appointed team leader… her first love from school days? And that massive tidal wave crashes head-on into Dan-Bi’s simple life!

“I don’t get it. The Lee Dan-Bi I know likes me.”

Faced with that dizzying sense of strangeness, her heart began to race wildly once again.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 해일주의보

synonyms: Sasada Embraces Her Oshi with the Power of Money

title.native: ササダはオカネで推しを抱く
title.romaji: Sasada wa Okane de Oshi wo Daku

215961.description:
The King of Assassins in the dark underworld and the leader of the "Wolf Organization"—the legendary 'Wolf King'—fails a mission for the first time. Heavily wounded, he retreats to China.

To investigate the secret of his parents' origins and fulfill his father’s dying wish, he becomes a "live-in son-in-law" for the Feng family.

He is no longer the Wolf King; he is now Jiang Hao.

A year ago, the dark world declared that the 'Wolf King' had fallen after his failed mission. But now, Jiang Hao has hidden his legendary identity within the city, ready to unleash a frenzy of revenge and slaughter!

title.native: 这个杀手是赘婿

215962.description:
The year is 1993, and everything begins again—with his memories intact. The murdered chaebol heir, Jo Jin-Hu, awakens after possessing the body of Cha Dae-U, an employee at a securities firm. With perfect memory and the knowledge of every hidden truth, he knows exactly who killed him and stole his company. This time… he'll make every last one of them pay.

(Source: Naver translated)
synonyms: The Genius Monster of a Chaebol Family

title.native: 재벌집 천재 괴물

215963.description:
“Turns out, I wasn’t a dirt spoon.”

At the very end of a life spent at rock bottom, I discovered the truth: my life, which should have been that of a third-generation chaebol heir, had been completely ‘switched’ with someone else’s! At the moment I gave up on everything in despair, I heard the irritating voice of my ancestral spirit, and I regressed to before my life had been switched. This time, I won’t let anyone take it away from me. A story about a true third-generation chaebol heir taking on the challenge of managing his family’s conglomerate, starting from the position that rightfully belongs to him.

(Source: Naver translated)
synonyms: I Was Actually a Third-Generation Chaebol
Turns Out I'm a Third-Generation Chaebol
It Turns Out I’m a Third-Generation Chaebol

title.native: 알고보니 재벌 3세
異世界転生したら愛犬ベスのほうが強かったんだが ～職業街の人でも出来る宿屋経営と街の守り方～
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei Shitara Aiken Beth no Hou ga Tsukattanda ga: Shokugyou Gai no Hito demo Dekiru Yadoya Keiei to Gai no Mamori Hou

title.romaji: Isekai Tensei Shitara Aiken Beth no Hou ga Tsukattanda ga: Shokugyou Gai no Hito demo Dekiru Yadoya Keiei to Gai no Mamori Hou

A collection of one-shots by Shunichi and Naoki Karasawa originally published between 1988-1990.

1. Koutetsu Ningen 28-gou (鋼鉄人間28号)
2. Genshi Baka Shuurai (原子馬鹿襲来)
3. Shuutamura Satsujin Jiken (宗田村殺人事件)
4. Shokoku Ayashige Monogatari: Dankichi no Kai (諸国怪態物語　段吉の怪)
5. Manzai Baskervilles-ke no Inu (漫才バスカビル家の犬)

8. Mimizuku Kozou no Bauken (ミミヅク小僧のバウケン)

10. Gurutto Mawatte Jaguar no Me (ぐるっと回ってジャガーの眼)

title.native: 近未来馬鹿

215967.description:
Lawrence Gu reads minds. It helped him ace every test and land the president's seat. Then he interviewed Ron Lee, a gloomy applicant whose thoughts screamed: "I'll kill you!" So Lawrence made him his secretary. What else could he do? Let a potential criminal walk out the door? But here's the real question: is Lawrence trying to save Ron or falling for the one person who wants him dead?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Secretary Wants to Kill Me!
title.native: 我的秘書總想殺了我！
title.romaji: Wo de Mishu Zong Xiang Shale Wo!

title.romaji: Fuguu "Tamer" na Seide Party wo Tsuihou Sareta node, Henkyou de Slow Life wo Okurimasu: Yakutatazu to Tsuihou Sareta Otoko, Henkyou Kaitaku no Shuwan wa Ichiryuu ni Tsuki......!

title.native: 雲隠れロマンティック
お求めいただいた暴君陛下の悪女です
title.romaji: Omotome Itadaita Boukun Heika no Akujo desu

215975.description:
Shouyou High School of Science and Technology is an elite STEM academy packed with hardcore research geeks. Despite excelling strictly in the humanities, Yukito Natsume begins his high school life here, constantly feeling out of place. It is there that he meets Rin Amamiya, an eccentric genius who only speaks through a robot, and Rio Kujou, a STEM-pilled gyaru who seems cheerful and carefree on the outside but is surprisingly earnest.

Determined to find something he truly wants to do, Yukito decides to help Rin with her research, reviving the school's defunct Digital Research Club. For some reason, Rio ends up joining too... Set in a school full of science minds, one common goal sparks two different romances. A youthful romantic comedy that defies all logic!

title.native: 初恋あるごりずむ
天智ミコトは堕天使を知らない
title.romaji: Tenchi Mikoto wa Datenshi wo Shiranai

synonyms: A Young Brother Who Has an Older Brother with a Crossdressing Habit

title.romaji: Josou Aniki, Josou Kuse no Ani wo Motsu Otouto

title.native: それいけ！平安部
夫に愛されなかった公爵夫人の離婚調停
title.romaji: Otto ni Aisare Nakatta Koushaku Fujin no Rikon Choutei

215980.description:
[Stubborn but soft-hearted prime minister top x Double faced top scholar bottom]

Enemies are easily made but difficult to resolve. Shen Moqing and Lu Cangming have fought for over ten years, but in the end they find that the one who understands them best is each other.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: On Bamboo Horseback Came the Lad

title.native: 郎骑竹马来

215981.description:
[A Narcissistic "Foolish" Prince VS A Cold-Blooded Assassin]

Liu Yunmo, a martial arts assassin, unexpectedly saves the fourth prince, Wen Qianshan, who faked his death during a coup, and is entrusted by the prince himself to escort him back to the capital. On the way, they are pursued by Regent King Wu. When Wen Qianshan is killed, Liu Yunmo is trapped in an endless cycle of regression.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 殿下今天被刺了吗

215982.description:
Shi Qi, a lawyer who died from overwork, transmigrated into a multi-partner novel, becoming the scumbag top who pushed Feng Ran into darkness. Out of respect for the law, Shi Qi decideds to spare the pitiful Feng Ran from the story's plot. However, Shi Qi didn't expect that the original canary would be reborn and blacken, approaching him with the anger and resentment of his past life, causing him to fall and become prey. But in the end, it was the vengeful Feng Ran who cried uncontrollably. "Shi Qi, please love me again." It turns out that the hunter and the prey were destined from the very beginning of the story…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.native: 诱捕恶犬

215983.description: One-shot published in Horror Gourmet volume two.

title.native: ドロマイト

title.english: It's Just a Dream...Right?! - Side Story
title.native: 꿈자리가 이상한데요?! 외전
星のこわれる音

215986.description:
Shi Ji, the highest-ranking commander of the Federation was cold and beautiful, disciplined and dangerous – an untouchable flower on a high peak. Unexpectedly, his previous Beta secondary gender differentiated. He looked at the 'Omega' on the test report and calmly tossed it into the trash. He didn't need an Alpha, he thought. But why is there this little pup, always throwing himself at him, not knowing when to quit?

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)
synonyms: The Cold Commander Cried When He Kissed

title.native: 高冷指挥官一亲就哭
title.romaji: Gaoleng Zhihuiguan Yi Qin Jiu Ku

215987.description:
I want to be your pet…

It's New Year's Eve and Fumiharu Matsunaga (19 years-old) is unable to visit his family due to a blizzard. His heat is near, so he knows he shouldn't go out, but when from his window he spots national-treasure-level hottie Tamaki Kamioka (24 years-old) covered in snow, he rushes to bring him indoors. At first, Fumiharu is flustered by naughty Tamaki's sweet advances, but gradually he starts to warm up to them... Now he can't escape from his clingy pet's obsessive adoration! Is this a master's destiny...?!

A Peerless Obsessive Puppy dog Alpha & Upbeat Captive Virgin Omega's lust-filled, immoral Omegaverse!

(Source: CLLENN)

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for 12 chapters. In the volume releases, Chapters 1 and 2 were combined as Chapter 1, Chapters 5 and 6 as Chapter 4, and Chapters 9 and 10 as Chapter 7.
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Hit Me If I Tease You
title.native: おいたしたらぶって♡

215988.description:
Megumu, who always wears his hair down and goes unnoticed, is actually a total heartthrob full of piercings! After school, Himeno, who discovers that side, gradually finds himself drawn to him. But… why does he hide his face!?

The secret relationship between these two—one with a visual contrast and the other, unconsciously pure!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

title.native: めぐむくんは隠したい

215990.description:
Former child star Shinto is now the successful president of a child actor agency, but meeting aloof magazine editor Shikata leaves him intrigued. He soon discovers Shikata is actually Minato, his former co-star and first love whom he’s searched for years. Overjoyed yet confused by Minato’s transformation, Shinto is stunned when Minato proposes a physical relationship.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Take a Breath and Look at Me

title.native: 息を吐いて俺を見て
title.romaji: Iki wo Haite Ore wo Mite

215991.description:
In near-future Earth, a new Ice Age has taken hold—and after a world war, the winners cling to what few non-frozen paradises remain on the surface, while the losers dwell under the sea and begin to evolve into something else. But once these undersea survivors obtain a new, unheard-of flying craft, will they manage to rule over the planet once more?

(Source: K MANGA)

title.native: プロトコル・リュウグウ

215992.description:
Punishment for a wrongdoing is the "Half-Animal Half-Human Punishment". Women who ruined someone's lives have to serve a hikikomori with their "whole bodies"...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

報告書は、嘘をつく
鉄血電脳商舎
敷かれた運命も使いよう

215996.description:
This manga features plenty of women who desperately want to be "devoured" by older women—who may or may not have ulterior motives—as well as older women who are eager to "devour" those very women.

(source: No. 9, translated)

Note: Released at COMITIA 122.
